Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
I can’t overstate how important tomorrow’s election is.
#

Friends —
I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.
No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.
And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.
National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. **But I refuse to let them win.**
I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — [**will you donate $3 if you agree?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-nov22.ftVLpg&refcode=em221107-3-7&t=1&akid=4729%2E6688874%2EaPMZng)
I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for some extreme Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — [**if you agree, will you donate $3?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-nov22.ftVLpg&refcode=em221107-3-7&t=2&akid=4729%2E6688874%2EaPMZng)
Science, data, and facts have helped me solve some of the most difficult challenges in my life. And I think we need more members of Congress who are willing to put politics aside and do the same.
[**I can’t overstate how important tomorrow's election is. Chip in $3 today if you’re ready to help me win re-election and defend our majority >>**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-nov22.ftVLpg&refcode=em221107-3-7&t=3&akid=4729%2E6688874%2EaPMZng)

subject: Why Northern Nevada Community Leaders Support Adam Laxalt for US Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laxalt for Senate
body:
If we sit on the sidelines, out-of-touch Democrats will continue to destroy our country, our economy, and our communities.

A brief message in support of Adam Laxalt from Retired Hospitality Executive Cindy Carano and Sparks City Councilwoman Charlene Bybee:

Inflation in Nevada is over 16%. In Reno, gasoline prices reached highs of $7.00 per gallon last summer. Nevada has seen a 13.9% decrease (https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftracktherecovery.org%2F&data=05%7C01%7C%7Cf1686bcff2da48699b1208dac0fa1e02%7C84df9e7fe9f640afb435aaaaaaaaaaaa%7C1%7C0%7C638034477722823447%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=ozuG3ERr1wTaeJqJbawOglqXwlIqY8jzGa0mhqVDeYI%3D&reserved=0) in the number of small businesses open since the start of the lockdowns the Democrats implemented during the 2020 Covid scare. More than 4 million illegal immigrants
(https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cbp.gov%2Fnewsroom%2Fstats%2Fsouthwest-land-border-encounters&data=05%7C01%7C%7Cf1686bcff2da48699b1208dac0fa1e02%7C84df9e7fe9f640afb435aaaaaaaaaaaa%7C1%7C0%7C638034477722823447%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=1xJFNLGuOESSUKCPlOSSZ2iwQ2tpyU7PXhwL2nixWg0%3D&reserved=0) have crossed our border since President Biden took office. Homelessness (https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnews3lv.com%2Fnews%2Flocal%2Fstudy-nevada-has-9th-highest-rate-of-homelessness-nationwide&data=05%7C01%7C%7Cf1686bcff2da48699b1208dac0fa1e02%7C84df9e7fe9f640afb435aaaaaaaaaaaa%7C1%7C0%7C638034477722823447%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=WVkLaFSCBGXSsL%2FyC%2BiXONMhBfNfEeaJiyvAivlkzQQ%3D&reserved=0) , violent crime
(https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.rpc.senate.gov%2Fpolicy-papers%2Famerican-crime-story&data=05%7C01%7C%7Cf1686bcff2da48699b1208dac0fa1e02%7C84df9e7fe9f640afb435aaaaaaaaaaaa%7C1%7C0%7C638034477722823447%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=itZ8Y8ZbncpmV6sOUveHLjJtrZoj2eEp3B0%2Brxv3GHM%3D&reserved=0) and drug use (https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fnida.nih.gov%2Fresearch-topics%2Ftrends-statistics%2Foverdose-death-rates&data=05%7C01%7C%7Cf1686bcff2da48699b1208dac0fa1e02%7C84df9e7fe9f640afb435aaaaaaaaaaaa%7C1%7C0%7C638034477722823447%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=bOw9%2FL5q1UNqtXDUoZGW2vZWNRhyc6lU9rwz%2FFeK76o%3D&reserved=0) are visibly rising in our cities.

On Tuesday, Nevadans will have a choice to make between reelecting Cortez Masto or choosing a new direction and voting for Adam Laxalt. Cortez Masto and the Democrat party have been in complete control of the federal government for two years now. When deciding which candidate to choose, Nevadans must ask themselves one simple question: is life in Nevada improving or have the politicians in power only made the problems worse?

The answer is clear. Under Democrat control, everything has become worse than it was two years ago. Joe Biden and Democrats in the Senate like Cortez Masto have proven incapable of handling skyrocketing inflation and the open border crisis. In fact, they often deny that these problems exist. And rather than supporting our law enforcement agencies, Cortez Masto has called them racist and voted to confirm Biden’s appointees who support defunding the police.

Let’s not forget how poorly Democrat leadership handled the Covid crisis. Starting in 2020 (https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ktnv.com%2Fnews%2Fcoronavirus%2Ftimeline-for-coronavirus-pandemic-in-nevada&data=05%7C01%7C%7Cf1686bcff2da48699b1208dac0fa1e02%7C84df9e7fe9f640afb435aaaaaaaaaaaa%7C1%7C0%7C638034477722823447%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=n4%2Fi1gfitZvTrP7CLc1iLAy9jkqzuEcg0rAlewXMawg%3D&reserved=0) , I saw our working class forced out of work
(https://nam12.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fapnews.com%2Farticle%2Fcoronavirus-pandemic-lifestyle-health-travel-las-vegas-ddb7055a7ed178b94b799b2b1ec50d75&data=05%7C01%7C%7Cf1686bcff2da48699b1208dac0fa1e02%7C84df9e7fe9f640afb435aaaaaaaaaaaa%7C1%7C0%7C638034477722823447%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C3000%7C%7C%7C&sdata=y6dP9h9VQYqDQ3ADVTj6vPVtaF2aDImC4LBwe8UCbTE%3D&reserved=0) and our schools closed without any input from the people. Cortez Masto was nowhere to be found when Nevadans were struggling the most. Businesses in Nevada have still not fully recovered, and yet, Biden and Cortez Masto continue to pass radical liberal tax-and-spend policies that will only make inflation worse.

Nevada communities were hit harder than most because of our gaming and tourism industries. The City of Sparks used 43% of our federal CARES Act funding to help our businesses, residents and seniors. Today our residents and businesses are hurting more due to the federal policies creating inflation. Everyday families, seniors and our veterans can’t afford groceries, gas and heating bills.

Furthermore, our southern border is wide open to fentanyl, human trafficking, and illegal immigration, but Cortez Masto denies that there is any problem at all. In fact, she has not been to the border in years. Instead of voting to secure our border, instead of using her deciding vote in the Senate to hold Joe Biden accountable and fight for Nevadans, Cortez Masto has consistently voted with Joe Biden’s radical left policies nearly 100% of the time.

We have a choice this election to choose a new direction. Adam Laxalt will stand against Joe Biden’s radical left agenda and use his vote to put Nevada first. He will fight to secure our border, support our law enforcement, and stop this radical inflationary spending that’s pushing us further into a recession.

Your vote is crucial in this fight to save Nevada. It’s up to us to unite and get out the vote for Adam Laxalt. If we sit on the sidelines, out-of-touch Democrats will continue to destroy our country, our economy, and our communities. We can't let that happen.

Please, make sure that you have a plan to vote on Election Day. We must take action to elect Adam Laxalt as our next U.S. Senator.

Regards,

Charlene Bybee, Sparks City Councilwoman

Cindy Carano, Retired Hospitality Executive

subject: Why Southern Nevada Leaders Support Adam Laxalt

body:
If we sit on the sidelines, out-of-touch Democrats will continue to destroy our country, our economy, and our communities. |

| | **A brief message in support of Adam Laxalt from Former Nevada Governor Bob List and Nevada State Senator Joe Hardy:**

The US Senate is comprised of lockstep Democrats. It would have been nice if Nevada Senators could have distanced themselves from failed Biden policies by voting ‘No.’ Biden’s soft-on-crime attitude has not stopped the recurring news of felonies that social workers can’t fix without a strong police presence. We need to take a stand against Biden’s weak agenda. The current US Senate has not stepped up to the president and said, ‘No.’ ‘No’ to crime. ‘No’ to inflation. ‘No’ to years of school knowledge lost. ‘No’ to the lack of accountability by our youth without parents. My question is, when will this change? It needs to change today. Change the Senate. Vote for Adam Laxalt. His election will literally change the Senate for the better. The sooner the better.

Inflation in Nevada is over 16%. In Reno, gasoline prices reached highs of $7.00 per gallon last summer. Nevada has seen a [13.9% decrease](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=5ed4833008&e=018ab83301) in the number of small businesses open since the start of the lockdowns the Democrats implemented during the 2020 Covid scare. [More than 4 million illegal immigrants](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=aa46fbecdc&e=018ab83301) have crossed our border since President Biden took office. [Homelessness](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=8917d124f3&e=018ab83301), [violent crime](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=c966390c09&e=018ab83301) and [drug use](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=2859057b2c&e=018ab83301) are visibly rising in our cities.

On Tuesday, Nevadans will have a choice to make between reelecting Cortez Masto or choosing a new and better direction and voting for Adam Laxalt. Cortez Masto and the Democrat party have been in complete control of the federal government for two years now. When deciding which candidate to choose, Nevadans must ask themselves one simple question: is life in Nevada improving or have the politicians in power only made the problems worse?

The answer is clear. Under Democrat control, everything has become worse than it was two years ago. Joe Biden and Democrats in the Senate like Cortez Masto have proven incapable of handling skyrocketing inflation and the open border crisis. In fact, they often deny that these problems exist. And rather than supporting our law enforcement agencies, Cortez Masto has voted to confirm the very Biden appointees who support defunding the police.

Let’s not forget how poorly Democrat leadership handled the Covid crisis. [Starting in 2020](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=ebf031bb2d&e=018ab83301), I saw our working class [forced out of work](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=9e54318337&e=018ab83301) and our schools closed without any input from the people. Cortez Masto would still not vote against the Biden agenda. Businesses in Nevada have still not fully recovered, and yet, Biden and Cortez Masto continue to pass radical tax-and-spend policies that have only made inflation worse.

Our southern border is wide open to fentanyl, human trafficking, and illegal immigration, and Cortez Masto continues to support Biden’s agenda at the border. She could have improved our situation at the border with her one, single vote, but she did not. She supports Joe Biden’s radical policies nearly 100 percent of the time.

She continues to divide the country. Her vote would have been a healing influence on the country had she opposed Biden’s agenda. She had a chance to heal the division in this country, and she didn’t do it.

We have a choice this election to choose a new direction. Adam Laxalt will stand against Joe Biden’s radical agenda and use his vote to put Nevada and the nation first. Adam will bring the nation together. He will help heal the nation by securing our border, supporting our law enforcement, and stopping this radical inflationary spending that’s pushing us further into a recession.

Your vote is crucial in this fight to save Nevada. It’s up to us to unite and get out the vote for Adam Laxalt and our nation. If we sit on the sidelines, out-of-touch Democrats will continue on the path to destroy our way of life, our economy, our communities, and, ultimately, our country. We can't let that happen.

Please, make sure that you vote on Election Day. We must take action to elect Adam Laxalt as our next U.S. Senator, and as the leader who will take us in a positive direction.

Regards,

**Bob List, Former Nevada Governor (1979-1983)**

**Joe Hardy, Nevada State Senator (2010-Present)**

body:
The stakes are too high for us to fall short.

Friend,

clean_body: | | | I'm having trouble sleeping at night, team. Every day, I hear more and more really smart people say a "red wave" is coming, and that worries me -- because control of the Senate is at stake tomorrow, and these GOP Senate candidates are absolutely BONKERS. We've got snake oil salesman Dr. Oz running in Pennsylvania, Silicon Valley corporate lackey J.D. Vance running in Ohio, and anti-democracy wackos running in Nevada and Arizona. All of them are groveling at Trump's feet and hoping that it's enough to overshadow their absolute unfitness for office. These jokers would be a disaster in the Senate, but right now it's looking like they all could win -- which would hand the Senate over to Mitch McConnell! If that happens, we can kiss any chance of protecting reproductive rights, expanding voting rights, or confirming Supreme Court justices goodbye. At that point, we might as well just call the billionaires' accountants and let them know that massive tax breaks are on the way! The fact is, team, if we lose the Senate, we're toast. There are folks all over the country who haven’t voted, or don’t know how or where to vote. We can still reach them -- but that’ll require the full and immediate support of this grassroots team. Can I count on you to make a $7 donation to the DNC right away? I hope you'll give whatever you can to help the DNC mobilize voters in these very final hours. Your investment couldn’t be more important in making sure we can turn out the vote and help Democratic candidates up and down the ballot nationwide cross the finish line. Vote November 8th!

PRESS RELEASE - NOV 7TH

KLIPPERT CONDEMNS ILLEGAL BALLOT HARVESTING IN WA

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Nov. 7, 2022, Kennewick, WA. Brad Klippert, the Republican write-in candidate for Washington's Secretary of State, believes that
every single citizen in WA State deserves to have the right to know that when they cast their ballot it will not be manipulated in
any way, shape, or form.

If elected, one of Rep. Klippert’s top priorities is to address the problem of ballot harvesting in Washington State. Ballot
Harvesting is NOT addressed in the Revised Code of WA...so it is legal in our state in many forms.

It’s well known throughout Washington state that some organizations hold registration events to get people to register to vote,
and then give them some kind of remuneration to get control of their ballot. They entice the new voter with gifts and sometimes
even intimidate them. Because the ballots are then controlled by someone other than the registered voter, this form of ballot
harvesting undermines voter confidence in elections in Washington state.

All voting in Washington is done vote-by-mail, so these ballots are extremely valuable, and can be used to influence the outcome
of any election at any level: local, county, state or federal. Klippert has vowed to work with the legislature to outlaw illegal
ballot harvesting practices and impose meaningful penalties for the illegal ballot harvesting practices.

Rep. Brad Klippert is a seven-term Republican state representative who is well versed in Washington state election laws. Klippert
vows to work with the legislature to end illegal ballot harvesting and many other “legal” ways to cheat that have been introduced
into law over the many years of one-party Democratic control of the Washington state legislature. On the Heritage Election
Integrity Scorecard [https://email.mg.msgsndr.org/c/eJxNj0lrwzAUhH9NdDRarO2gQxd6Kmmg0Lq5FPnpxRaRF2QTJ_--8q3wDsMMzJsPfmNw2419nJuHlM2E-nF9zS_3T5Im2LPvr3g8Nbfr86ntWfxpzu9HS3DwMf2ujxkd-GH2sRtJdJxyzhg1lFFJRSXBIAhT22B5i1ocajp01bB0yxhyNeWO9E4HD1LYwI0SqkgKxrQQuNatqYW2JLl-XeflIJ4O_K3ctm1VjzmuvsO9o1iYENY4jQtMGcHnULw4BrxX_Tokkl2Yt5hSXJQuE7p9egXT8A9i5yz_rWf1xRuvmKY1A49USiTomFLaKFuYSHAGLsIr-gfqsGOB], Washington state is near the bottom of the list, tied
for 45th in reference to secure election processes.

Rep. Klippert has been endorsed by the Washington State Republican Party [https://email.mg.msgsndr.org/c/eJxNj7tuhDAQRb8Gl2gM2NiFizyUKtqsFCkh26zMeAAL85BBS_j7QBfpdqe45-DdO7M9-Met2oWoJir3_jW-_H6yMOHJvr_85Vo9-udr3XH_U93eL5rRYH24r_tMBu0wW9-OzJsMsoxzUMBBQJ4KVIS5KrTTWU1lnhQwtOmwtMvoYjrFlnWm1gTQONugKgoSqpG1ArBZjRaRk2XBdOs6L0n-lGRvx7ZtS7foV_JjH_w8U1xTnIaDsGjcvPkQ_CLL46s9HU_2z_YMkrnUlheNVVbyEgqOlkAIYmS4lKWS-pBnzihscivhD4ENXCo], and 31 out of 39 of
the county GOP Committees. He’s also been endorsed by The Conservative Ladies of Washington State, and the organization We Believe
We Vote. The campaign has captured the excitement and enthusiasm of grassroots Republicans from all across the state.

Because of Klippert’s strong support for transparent and fair elections, The NW Progressive Institute even labeled Brad Klippert
“an ultra MAGA Republican.” In response, Klippert said, “If pledging to do everything I can to ensure Security, Integrity and
Transparency in Washington State’s election process makes me ‘an ultra MAGA Republican’ I will proudly wear that title!”

| |
# Friends of Cavaleri for Congress,
---
| Tomorrow, at 8pm, ballot boxes close. We will spend one more day sign waving and phonebanking, and then it’s up to you to make your voice heard on Election Day. For 15 months, we have been charging hard to the November 8th finish line. America desperately needs balance restored and common-sense values returned to our families.

The Democrats controlling the House, Senate, and Oval Office has been an epic disaster. Post-pandemic America should be thriving, but clearly it is not. Damaging economic and energy policies, soft-on-crime policies, and detrimental border policies have plunged America into one of its most dangerous and economically disastrous times in our history.

_All of this in just two short years._

Taking back the House of Representatives is the first step in restoring balance to a corrupted vessel. Please make sure you cast your ballot for me, Vincent Cavaleri, in Washington’s First Congressional District. **_I will always choose people over politics._**
Thank you; God bless you and God bless the United States of America.

# **FACT: Data-Driven Predictions Favor Laxalt**
---
| In 2014, Nevada blogger Jon Ralston – a diehard hater of Adam Laxalt – predicted Laxalt would lose his race for attorney general. Ralston was wrong, just as his predictions were wrong that year for the races for secretary of state, the 4th congressional district, and control of the NV State Assembly. Ralston has once again let his hatred for Laxalt cloud his judgement, and he will once again be proven wrong when Laxalt defeats Joe Biden’s rubber stamp in the Senate, Catherine Cortez Masto. As [many people have noted](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=5d647f32a8&e=018ab83301 "https://twitter.com/search?q=ralston%20laxalt&src=typed_query&f=live"), Ralston’s feelings fly in the face of the actual data. Ralston’s prediction, however, is certainly in line with the ad dollars Masto gave Ralston’s pay-to-play blog this campaign cycle. Here’s a look at the current NV Senate predictions from data-driven analysts who aren’t suffering from a political derangement syndrome:
* FiveThirtyEight: [Laxalt wins 57 times out of 100](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=45352ffa60&e=018ab83301 "https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/2022-election-forecast/senate/nevada/")

* Decision Desk HQ: [Laxalt has a 55% probability of winning](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=dd53836c05&e=018ab83301 "https://twitter.com/DecisionDeskHQ/status/1589343108306796546")

* CNalysis: [Tilts Republican](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=469d4668b6&e=018ab83301 "https://projects.cnalysis.com/21-22/senate")

* Real Clear Politics: [Republican Pick Up](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=ad7f047ffd&e=018ab83301 "https://www.realclearpolitics.com/epolls/2022/senate/elections-map-rcp-projection.html")

As [the Washington Post’s Henry Olsen](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=3b6ebe3063&e=018ab83301 "https://www.washingtonpost.com/opinions/2022/11/07/midterm-elections-2022-prediction-house-senate-forecast/") writes today, it’s “easy to predict that Republican Adam Laxalt will comfortably win Nevada. Biden is consistently less popular there than he is nationwide. The state’s Republican Senate nominees won an average of 45 percent in 2016 and 2018, and Laxalt will likely improve upon that by a few points in this much more pro-GOP environment. That’s more than enough for him to win.” Laxalt’s lead in the [Real Clear Politics polling average](https://adamlaxalt.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=da4abd80675c7148be5f8e45a&id=dc687bfab4&e=018ab83301 "https://www.realclearpolitics.com/epolls/2022/senate/nv/nevada_senate_laxalt_vs_cortez_masto-7392.html") is 2.7%. body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi, it’s Charles Booker. It’s late, and I’m writing from my phone, so I’ll
be brief.

I’m running for Senate in Kentucky because I want my daughters to grow up
in a country where the government doesn’t treat them as second-class
citizens.

I’m running for Senate to take care of our veterans and to provide
affordable housing, better infrastructure, better wages, clean air, and
clean water.

I’m running for Senate to protect our democracy.

With just one day left to get all our voters to the polls, I need your
help: So, I hope you’ll pitch in $20 or more to help me win this
election.

You can use this secure link to donate: [ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18848?t=1001&akid=2743%2E346206%2E4CHdUg ]ActBlue/charlesb221107

My name is Charles Booker. I’m on a mission to defeat Rand Paul and
restore leadership to the Senate and representation for Kentucky, from the
Hood to the Holler.

Thank you,

Charles

| | Dear , TIME TO DECIDE ** ** Massachusetts And Nation Face Most Consequential Election Since Civil War ** ** ** ** On this beautiful evening, it is hard to imagine that in the past few days and weeks, culminating on Tuesday, our nation will render a decision that will either reaffirm our legacy of freedom, or extinguish it. The last time this nation faced such a choice was in 1860 when Abraham Lincoln was elected and the south seceded, launching our tragic civil war. The dawn of the 21st century has seen rancor and bitterness re-injected into American politics, after a long respite, and while the Republican party has been less than stellar in its performance, the core element behind this hardening of our political discourse has been the progressive wing of the Democratic party. Unlike the old Democratic party and other political parties in American history, which were formed by coalitions of interests trying to impact American policy, the progressive wing of the Democratic party is now purely ideological. Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi, Chuck Schumer, Hillary Clinton and every Democrat that holds a seat, whether in our state legislature or in Congress is now part of an ideological movement, akin to an organized crime syndicate. Their party has adopted “Democratic Centralism” as its operating model. This method, used by dictators, limits policy decisions to only a select few (usually the most sociopathic), forcing everyone else to follow suit or face political liquidation. This is why today, unlike so many years ago, you never see Democrats disagreeing publicly among themselves, to do so is political suicide. Look at what happened to Tulsi Gabbard, when she dared to break ranks. John Adams once described Ideology as “ the science of idiots”. The policies of both national and state Democrats affirm his statement. Driven by fanatical climate activists, who drive the progressive agenda, we have destroyed our domestic energy capacity. Through massive public spending we have corrupted our money supply, causing inflation. We are now facing the prospect of limited fuel for the winter and food shortages. This is idiotic public policy. No matter how much velvet they use to cover their metal fist, ideological movements will eventually put their boot heels on people’s throats to advance their agenda. We have seen that with the vaccine mandates, where coercion was used to force compliance and with the insane decisions of Governors Andrew Cuomo in New York and Thomas Wolf in Pennsylvania, who actually committed mass murder with their ego driven decisions to mix covid patients with the healthy in nursing homes. Lastly, it is with children that an ideological movement seems to reveal its most diabolical fetish. Progressives seek to poison them with sexual ideologies that will only confuse and harm them. This movement is out to hurt you and your family. It is time to end this madness. You have a chance to stop it this Tuesday, take advantage of your right to vote. Do not offer the excuse that it is not worth it, or that the election is rigged. In Poland during the rise of Solidarity, elections were rigged by the Communist government, but the workers went and voted anyway to publicly demonstrate their power and to expose the fraud. Get to the polls and vote. Editorial ELECTION RUNDOWN: ** ** Just Remember All R’s and All N’s ** ** **US Congress:** ** ** Vote Dean Tran: An experienced former Republican state senator, Dean is a person whose history makes him uniquely qualified to lead the charge for freedom in Massachusetts. He is a solid conservative and has demonstrated courage and tenacity in his political career. His Democrat opponent simply does what Joe and Nancy tell her to do. ** ** **Governor/ Lt Governor :** ** ** Vote Geoff Diehl and Leah Cole Allen: They are Republicans and basic conservatives, who will support the free enterprise system and the Constitution. Geoff’s opponent is perhaps the most ruthless and corrupt ideologue of all. As Attorney General she was nowhere to be found during the state police scandal. She took pride in cutting off needed energy resources for this Commonwealth and she affirmed the violence radical left in Portland and Seattle during the summer of 2020. She is the queen of chaos and a vote for her is a vote for lawlessness. ** ** **Attorney General** ** ** Vote Jay MacMahon: A former military police officer in the Mass National Guard, and an attorney. He is a Republican, who has been a strong advocate for law and order. He has been aggressive on the question of illegal immigration and controlling the influx of fentanyl into the state. His opponent is the daughter of one of Boston's most infamous gangsters. Alvin Campbell distributed drugs for Whitey Bulger into Roxbury. Her brother is a serial rapists. Why do you think she is about defunding the police and doing away with bail ? **Secretary of State:** ** ** Vote Rayla Campbell: We desperately need her passion for liberty injected into our state government. A grass roots Republican, who cares about home, family and justice. Her opponent is a long time Democrat, who goes along with any program advanced by progressives to obstruct your right to vote. Rayla will also expose the clandestine effort to corrupt the moral thinking of your children and grandchildren through ideologically driven, sex-based literature. ** ** **Auditor:** ** ** Vote Anthony Amore: He is a former law enforcement official and currently head of security at the Elizabeth Gardner museum. Give this Republican a chance to shed some light on our corrupt state government. **State Legislature:** ** ** Vote for candidates Karla Miller, Raymond Xie , Andrew Shepherd, Aaron Packard, Sal DeFranco, Bruce Chester, Rodney Cleaves and anyone else who has Republican next to their names. The state legislature is nothing more than a puppet show. You have no representation there. It is a farse. Every Democrat, and even some of the Republicans are part of the syndicate. The leadership has bought everyone off. We need to flush them all down the drain. These are new people and untainted by Beacon Hill corruption. ** ** **Question # 1: Millionaires Tax ** ** ** Vote No: Any who tells you this will only affect a few people is a “liar”. This will radically reshape income tax assessments in Massachusetts. The 1M tag line is the bait. You losing your flat tax protection is the switch. If this passes, that “sucking sound” you will hear will be all of the state’s investment capital leaving town. **Question # 2: Dental Health Regulation** ** ** Vote No. Any bill involving the regulation of a health care industry in Massachusetts should be suspect. Claims that this bill will force money away from administrative functions to you are laughable. Ask yourself why there is an administrative logjam in the first place. It was caused by government regulation. ** ** **Question # 3 Expand Liquor Licenses** ** ** Vote No: Don’t you think we have enough liquor establishments in Massachusetts ? ** ** **Question # 4 Driver's Licenses For Illegal Immigrants:** ** ** Vote No: This is critical for two reasons (1) if you vote yes, you will help undermine US immigration policy by creating an incentive for more illegal immigrants to cross the border and come here. (2) if you vote yes, you will undermine your own citizenship because obtaining a license also means registering to vote. It is automatic. You will be authorizing significant numbers of illegal aliens to vote in this Commonwealth. Someday you will wake up in this state and find that your citizenship will mean nothing. Don’t be fooled by commercials that portray police officers advocating for yes on this question. Those commercials were sponsored by SIEU, one of the most radical socialist unions in the country. I am willing to bet that the officer in the commercial is a fake. Any police officer who supports question# 4 is undermining his/her oath of office, which requires them to defend the US Constitution. By supporting question # 4 they have violated that oath. Re Westford Town Ballots: Positions on these issues have been previously posted. IZON urges Yes on 51 Main, an No on the Library.

body:
I wanted to make sure that you saw Beto's message.
#
Election Day is tomorrow, so I wanted to make sure that you saw Beto's message from this morning.
All of us need to do everything in our power to change the extreme and dangerous direction that our state is heading in, so I'm asking:
[**If you can, will you make a contribution of $3 to power our last voter outreach efforts to turn out the voters who will elect Beto? As Governor, Beto will be a leader for all Texans.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221107-4._CtPm-&refcode=ema20221107-216425&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=216425%2E444211%2EKHmLcT)
We have seen that Greg Abbott has no interest in building consensus or compromise. He has moved away from being a moderate Republican to one pushing extreme policies that infringe on our freedoms. Abbott has had eight years to do his job, but he has failed us — from the power grid failure, to increased gun violence due to permitless carry, to signing the most extreme abortion ban in the country with no exception for rape or incest.
**We can and must do better for families in Texas. Together, we can bring change to this state.**
I hope you will join us in whatever way you can.
Thank you,
Amy O'Rourke

body:
I know it’s late, but I hope you’ll read this.
#
Hi Peter,
I know it’s late, but I wanted to make sure you saw Pramila’s final message to you before Election Day.
There’s a lot riding on tomorrow’s election, and not just for Democratic control of Congress. Our democracy, our freedom, our rights to a good job, clean air and water, the ability to make our own health care decisions — all these things and more are on the line. Right now we need everyone on Team Jayapal to do what we can:
[**Before the polls open, will you rush a contribution of $27 or more?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22623?refcode=em20221107-1820&t=1&akid=1820%2E420207%2EqrgWiB)
Tomorrow, we leave it all on the field. Thanks for being with us in this fight.
— Lauren
* * *
Peter, it’s Pramila here...
I needed to make sure you hear how I’m feeling about tomorrow.
**Tomorrow promises to be an election** that could change our country forever. Everyone is facing a choice, and we have to believe voters will make the right one. But we owe it to ourselves to do everything we can until the moment polls close.
**I know that a Democratic majority allows progressives to continue pushing the country forward** on the issues that really matter: reproductive rights, climate action, living wages, immigration reform, labor protections, and so much more.
We’re up against a deadline none of us can ignore – the final and most important one of the past two years. **Our campaign is relying on a groundswell of grassroots donations** to get over the finish line AND bring other progressives with us, so we can grow our collective power in Congress.
[**The final 24 hours will be critical, and we simply must stay strong. That’s why I’m asking: can you chip in $27 or more to support us in our final push?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22623?refcode=em20221107-1820&t=2&akid=1820%2E420207%2EqrgWiB)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22623?refcode=em20221107-1820&t=21&akid=1820%2E420207%2EqrgWiB)**
We cannot drop the ball now. And it’s clear that Democrats are largely being outspent in the most influential election of my whole lifetime.
**Our progressive agenda hinges on the next 24 hours.** And I’m determined to do everything in my power to protect everything we’ve fought so hard for.
But none of us can do it all alone, so I need you to work with me if we’re going to win this election. We’re in this together, and we have to make every single minute count.
[**I believe so strongly in our grassroots movement, and I’m hoping to see our power with the donations we bring in over the next 24 hours. Will you be one of the donors to get us across the finish line when it really matters?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/22623?refcode=em20221107-1820&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=1820%2E420207%2EqrgWiB)
I KNOW we can do this — thank you for your time and support today,
Pramila
(Sent from my iPhone)

**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20221107-1820-footer&t=23&refcode2=1820_420207_qrgWiB&akid=1820%2E420207%2EqrgWiB)**

body:
Our party needs to rush more resources to the front lines in important battleground states where races up and down the ballot are still too close for comfort. | |
---
Derek, this election is a choice between two vastly different visions for America:
* Democrats are building an economy that grows from the bottom up and the middle out. Republicans are doubling down on their mega MAGA trickle-down economics that benefits the very wealthy. **It failed the country before and will fail us again.**

* Democrats are going to protect Social Security and Medicare. Republicans have stated boldly that they want to cut Social Security and Medicare.

* Republicans want to pass a national ban on abortion. If we elect more Senate Democrats and keep control of the House, we’re going to codify _Roe v. Wade._

Now, with so much at stake, our party needs to rush more resources to the front lines in important battleground states where races up and down the ballot are still too close for comfort. I truly wouldn’t be asking if it weren’t urgently necessary, so I am humbly asking: **Will you make a $7 donation to elect Democrats nationwide? Grassroots supporters have been chipping in all year long to power our work, but you haven’t stepped up this year to support the DNC. subject: Peter, ELECTION DAY IS TODAY
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mayra Flores for Congress
body:

| | | It's Mayra Flores here. It's ELECTION DAY and I just wanted to recap my journey for you as Americans DECIDE THE FATE OF OUR FUTURE.

I was born in Mexico and, when I was a young girl, I legally immigrated to the United States with my family. We didn't have much and worked in the hot Texan fields to make ends meet, but we always kept in mind that we were creating a better future for ourselves. [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61819440:J2OUSkGN8:m:1:3317145305:AD7DD1CC57D4892C23D834D747453CA2:r) I never would've thought that I would go on to become the first Mexico-born woman to ever be elected to Congress, and I can only contribute my election to my strong conservative beliefs in God, family, and country. [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61819440:J2OUSkGN8:m:1:3317145305:AD7DD1CC57D4892C23D834D747453CA2:r) Unfortunately, those are the very beliefs that the Democrats SEEK TO DESTROY, and they've proved that they'll DO ANYTHING to defeat me after I SHOCKED THEM by winning my June Special Election. body:
Hey Team,
It’s finally here. The day we’ve all been working for. We only have 13 HOURS LEFT to beat Jim Jordan and his extremist agenda. I need you all to remember how serious the consequences of a Jim Jordan victory could be, and understand that we have to do everything we can to make sure he does not win. He wants to TAKE AWAY YOUR FREEDOMS AND RIGHTS. He wants you to die if you have an ectopic pregnancy by stripping reproductive freedoms. He wants you to have to work UNTIL YOU DIE by depleting social security. And he doesn’t want you to get a say in any of this. He will roll back our voting rights until we are living in the 1800s again.
I know you all are sick of Jim Jordan. We all get that awful rage deep, deep down in our core whenever his name comes up in a headline, or when his ugly mug shows up on TV. You just want to yell, “shut up, you’re stealing mine and my children’s futures!” whenever he parrots a Republican fear-mongering point. Now is our chance to finally shut him up, to finally remove him from his perch high up in the Republican Party’s inner circle. NOW is our chance to replace him with a strong woman who has been an ADVOCATE for survivors, not abusers; who has been a CHAMPION for the working class, not for millionaires and billionaires; who has fought to defend our CONSTITUTION and its principles, not for the violent extremists who want to tear it up.
If this email sounds desperate, it’s because it is. Today is our LAST DAY to get the word out about Jim Jordan’s CORRUPTION AND LIES. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.” Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Peter,

Today is the day Floridians will make history and show the world that we will never back down from our mission to keep our state free.

In Florida, our rights are not up for grabs.

I know you realize the gravity of today, and you may have already cast your vote. If you did, thank you.

If you’ve already voted, will you pick up the phone and reach out to three friends or family members and encourage them to cast their ballots today?

You can make more of an impact through the conversations you have with your loved ones in 5 minutes than I’ll be able to make from a tweet, an ad, or a rally.

If you have not voted yet — the clock is ticking. We cannot afford to let a single vote go to waste this election, Peter. There is far too much on the line.

Today’s election is a referendum on the free state of Florida.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=339b9e32898dd0283885e8758723840fa297a6e7dc187123819ea82eb17accea2a546c587ee0e489d01363c8c2fcc14908a7c37a7061c5c6e2cf96f749f76ee8
FIND YOUR POLLING LOCATION

If you appreciate living in a free state where lockdowns and mandates have been ruled out, where kids are in school learning about the foundational principles of America, and where we proudly support our men and women in uniform who keep our streets safe, then I need you to make that known at the polls today.

This election, and the fate of our state, is in your hands now. What you do with that responsibility is up to you, Peter.

I hope I can count on your support. The clock is ticking, so get out and VOTE!

For a free Florida,
Ron DeSantis

# [#]Hi there,

Today is the day — Election Day!

The moment we’ve been working towards during this entire campaign is here. I would like to take a moment and say thank you for everything we accomplished this year. I couldn’t imagine having a better team going into Election Day.

We can defeat “Far-Right Frank” Pallotta and the dark-money groups backing him, we can pick representatives who will work for us and not themselves — but we have to vote. It’s up to us now — every friend, every family member, and every neighbor can make a difference today.

If you need help finding your polling place, click here. [https://nj.gov/state/elections/vote-polling-location.shtml]

If you need more information on this election, click here . [https://nj.gov/state/elections/vote.shtml]

Remember, Tuesday at 8pm is the deadline — be sure to either vote in person or return your ballot to a secure drop box or your county’s Board of Elections as early as possible!

Our values are the same — we believe in community over division and unity over hate.

In the most consequential election of our lifetime, no one can afford to sit this one out. We can win, but only if everyone participates. Have you voted yet? Has your neighbor?

Thank you for being on this journey with me.

Yours,

Josh

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54277277/377996772/327637188?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTUxNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOGUwM2VlMy01YzVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ppYCB8zprj5N9oG4ARlt-UywVQDMeVtTZhYwaXIx3ak=&emci=4299738c-f05e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=38e03ee3-5c5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=6566505) Hi Peter, Election Day is finally here! And all of the hard work this team put in is what got us to today. I wanted to take a moment to say, “Thank you!” for being part of this grassroots team. And if you haven’t voted yet, I need you to read this email. Your vote matters! Everything we've been working so hard toward comes down to today. **Here’s what you need to know about voting today:**
* **Bring your ID** : The majority of registered voters in Iowa have either an Iowa driver’s license or a non-operator ID. Voters who have neither are mailed an Iowa Voter Identification Card at the time they register to vote or update their registration. Voters can also present a U.S. passport, U.S. military or veteran ID, or Tribal ID card or document.

* **Polling places open at 7 a.m.** They close at 8 p.m. (They previously closed at 9 p.m., but that has changed – so **make sure you get to your polling place BEFORE 8 p.m.**)

* **Your polling place may have changed due to redistricting.** You can use this tool from the Iowa Secretary of State’s office to find your polling place: [**https://voterready.iowa.gov/**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54277279/377996774/-870321883?source=em22_221108_GOTV9_gotv_gq_act___LM_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221108_GOTV9_gotv_gq_act___LM_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTUxNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOGUwM2VlMy01YzVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ppYCB8zprj5N9oG4ARlt-UywVQDMeVtTZhYwaXIx3ak=&emci=4299738c-f05e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=38e03ee3-5c5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=6566505)

* **Absentee ballots must physically be at election offices by the time polls close on election day.** (This means postmarked ballots and Intelligent Mail no longer count.) If you still have your absentee ballot, take it with you to your local polling location and give it to the poll workers. They will give you a new Election Day ballot.

This election is critical for Iowans: getting the resources we deserve and need, health care – especially for Iowa women, increasing economic development and lowering costs while combating inflation, and protecting our agriculture and environment. We're counting on every single Iowan to make their voice heard. This is our chance to flip this seat from red to blue, and protect our Democratic majority in Congress. | [CONFIRM YOUR POLLING PLACE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54277287/377996777/-870321883?source=em22_221108_GOTV9_gotv_gq_act___LM_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_221108_GOTV9_gotv_gq_act___LM_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTUxNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOGUwM2VlMy01YzVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ppYCB8zprj5N9oG4ARlt-UywVQDMeVtTZhYwaXIx3ak=&emci=4299738c-f05e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=38e03ee3-5c5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=6566505)

subject: Here's y​​​​​our PA Election Day Handbook
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/90471/images/PDP%20Primary%20Logo.png]
PA Voters — Polling places in every county are now open to vote for our next Governor, Senator, and local Dems at every level! Go cast your vote, and reach out to friends to ensure they do the same.
WHO SHOULD I VOTE FOR?
Atop the ballot, make sure you choose our entire statewide slate of Democrats: Josh Shapiro for Governor and John Fetterman for U.S. Senate.
Then, vote for local Democrats all the way down your ballot. You can see all the Dems we support and the races on your local ballot at PADems.com/candidates. [https://padems.com/candidates?emci=282e5493-2f38-ec11-9820-c896653b26c8&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
GET VOTER GUIDE [ https://padems.com/candidates?emci=282e5493-2f38-ec11-9820-c896653b26c8&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
WHEN CAN I VOTE IN PERSON?
Polls are open from 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM. If you are in line at your polling location by 8 PM, please stay in line! You're entitled to vote regardless of what time your ballot is actually cast.
FIND POLLING PLACE [ http://iwillvote.com/pa]
HOW CAN I RETURN A MAIL BALLOT?
If you have a mail ballot, return it by hand by 8 PM tonight. You may drop ballots off at your county's elections office or a dropbox [http://iwillvote.com/pa] , but you may NOT return a ballot at your E-Day polling place.
FIND DROPOFF POINT [ http://iwillvote.com/pa]
WHAT IF I CAN'T RETURN MY BALLOT?
If you absolutely cannot drop your ballot off by 8 PM — or if your mail ballot did not arrive — you may still vote in person at your Election Day polling place.
If you have your mail ballot...
Take the ballot and its envelopes to your polling place, where it will be canceled so you can vote on a machine.
If you don't have your ballot...
Go to your polling place to request a provisional ballot.
If you can't travel at all...
Call 833-728-6837 for live, personalized support.
DO I NEED ID TO VOTE IN PERSON?
In Pennsylvania, you are NOT required to show identification UNLESS it’s your first time voting in your current precinct. If you are voting for the first time in a new location, you must show a valid form of identification. [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Register-to-Vote/Pages/Voter-ID-for-First-Time-Voters.aspx?emci=282e5493-2f38-ec11-9820-c896653b26c8&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]
If you believe someone at your polling place has improperly requested ID, please call PA Dems’ Voter Assistance Hotline at 833-728-6837.
WHAT ARE MY VOTING RIGHTS?
Visit https://www.vote.pa.gov/Your-Rights/?emci=282e5493-2f38-ec11-9820-c896653b26c8&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid= [https://www.vote.pa.gov/Your-Rights/?emci=282e5493-2f38-ec11-9820-c896653b26c8&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=] to familiarize yourself with your voting rights before you hit the polls.
If you believe your rights have been violated, don't leave the polling place. Immediately request a provisional ballot and call us at 833-728-6837.
For any other voting questions and concerns — or to report an issue at a polling place — call PA Dems' Voter Hotline at 1-833-PA-VOTES (1-833-728-6837).
You may also contact the state elections bureau at 1-877-868-3772 or www.vote.pa.gov. [https://www.vote.pa.gov/?emci=282e5493-2f38-ec11-9820-c896653b26c8&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=]

clean_body: [] PA Voters — Polling places in every county are now open to vote for our next Governor, Senator, and local Dems at every level! Go cast your vote, and reach out to friends to ensure they do the same. WHO SHOULD I VOTE FOR? Atop the ballot, make sure you choose our entire statewide slate of Democrats: Josh Shapiro for Governor and John Fetterman for U.S. Senate. Then, vote for local Democrats all the way down your ballot. You can see all the Dems we support and the races on your local ballot at PADems.com/candidates. [=] GET VOTER GUIDE [ =] WHEN CAN I VOTE IN PERSON? Polls are open from 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM. If you are in line at your polling location by 8 PM, please stay in line! You're entitled to vote regardless of what time your ballot is actually cast. FIND POLLING PLACE [ ] HOW CAN I RETURN A MAIL BALLOT? If you have a mail ballot, return it by hand by 8 PM tonight. You may drop ballots off at your county's elections office or a dropbox [] , but you may NOT return a ballot at your E-Day polling place. FIND DROPOFF POINT [ ] WHAT IF I CAN'T RETURN MY BALLOT? If you absolutely cannot drop your ballot off by 8 PM — or if your mail ballot did not arrive — you may still vote in person at your Election Day polling place. If you have your mail ballot... Take the ballot and its envelopes to your polling place, where it will be canceled so you can vote on a machine. If you don't have your ballot... Go to your polling place to request a provisional ballot. If you can't travel at all... Call 833-728-6837 for live, personalized support. DO I NEED ID TO VOTE IN PERSON? In Pennsylvania, you are NOT required to show identification UNLESS it’s your first time voting in your current precinct. If you are voting for the first time in a new location, you must show a valid form of identification. [=] If you believe someone at your polling place has improperly requested ID, please call PA Dems’ Voter Assistance Hotline at 833-728-6837. WHAT ARE MY VOTING RIGHTS? Visit = [=] to familiarize yourself with your voting rights before you hit the polls. If you believe your rights have been violated, don't leave the polling place. Immediately request a provisional ballot and call us at 833-728-6837. For any other voting questions and concerns — or to report an issue at a polling place — call PA Dems' Voter Hotline at 1-833-PA-VOTES (1-833-728-6837). You may also contact the state elections bureau at 1-877-868-3772 or www.vote.pa.gov. [=] PA Democratic Party 229 State Street Harrisburg, PA 17101 United States []

Today’s the day, Derek. It’s finally Election Day. Everything we’ve been building towards comes down the actions that we take today. **So please, go vote!** Before you go to the polls, here’s some quick information about voting:

* Mail-in or absentee ballots must be placed in a drop box by 8 PM tonight.

Dear Friends, Supporters and Voters,
Today is the day of decision. Our country is in deep trouble. We are on a moral decline, inflation has us suffering economically, our wide-open border is a national security issue, and we cannot meet the energy needs of our people. America is in deep trouble, and we must turn this ship around.
Like any good competitor I must ask myself did I do my best. Do voters understand our message, did I run this race with integrity, and did I fight fair? The answer to those questions is yes. ### "Peter's financial discipline and ability to build consensus-based solutions served Menlo Park residents well."
#### \- _Former Mayors Catherine Carlton, Ray Mueller and Rich Cline_
Please [donate](https://www.peterohtaki.com/donate?e=3ff96535fdf3e69bdca7f1760cb2f7c7&utm_source=ohtaki&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wish_me_luck&n=4 "donate") to make a difference - we've knocked on every door in the district, sent two mailers, 130 yard signs, texts and digital ads.

Thank you!
Peter

Hello,
It was Ben Franklin who, when asked what form of government the constitutional convention had produced, said: “A republic, if you can keep it.”
Donald Trump’s election sealed the deal for me to retire after nearly 4 decades in the U.S. Navy. Having been in uniform for every President since Jimmy Carter, I showed my respect for Mr. Trump with my feet. I was done. It was apparent that the next four years would not go well.
Unfortunately, putting himself before his country culminated when Trump and his fellow Republicans planned, cajoled accomplices, then launched a domestic insurrection on the U.S. Capitol. Five lives were lost, and the nation’s innocence, as well. And it ain’t over.
January 6th set a precedent that leadership in a political party will condone political violence. **To this day, GOP members who continue to perpetuate the Big Lie are a direct threat to our democracy.** My opponent, Senator Chuck Grassley, who voted against Trump’s impeachment and tried to block a bipartisan commission from investigating the attack, still has yet to come clean.
The Republican party needs to cull its ranks of the active insurrectionists. Every single person involved in the January 6 attack needs to be held accountable for their actions, including sitting members of Congress who participated in the planning and execution of the insurrection.
**I’m running for the U.S. Senate against Senator Chuck Grassley because I place nation over baseless insurrection. It is a decision not entirely unlike the time of Lincoln. One does not serve the nation in military service to watch idly while it is dismembered by the likes of Donald Trump and his accomplices, to include Chuck Grassley.**
Chuck Grassley is blanketing the state with TV ads attacking me. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are spending boatloads more. I am the ultimate “hard target” for the Republicans, but to get elected, **I need your help one last time now if we're going to turn out the vote and win. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs – instead, I’m relying entirely on grassroots donors _like you_.**
[**Please, if you can afford to, donate a final $5 or more to my campaign right now – every dollar you can to fund our GOTV efforts – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54280578/378008097/-42398318?refcode=em20221108am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDI4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiN2Y2Zjc0My02NTVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J-Grn_6fsbQ3_2_C0ITDON7wBVppJleMBAB0abVyfCw=)

Today is Election Day!
Today is finally the day we **BEAT RON DESANTIS.** We’ve been working round the clock for months now to make sure everyone is registered to vote and our day is finally here.
I’m standing up for Floridians everywhere. For seniors, who can’t afford their life saving prescriptions, for women who have had their rights stripped away from them, for home owners who can’t afford the roof over their head, and for our LGBTQ+ community who is under constant threat of violence under Ron DeSantis’ poor leadership.

name: Andy Kim
subject: Take a moment with me
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Andy Kim for Congress
body:
After a months-long climb, we've reached the summit.
Before the polls close, I'm asking you to join me for a moment to appreciate the spirit of this movement and our successes so far:

Faced with a self-funding luxury yacht heir eager to pour millions of dollars into his run for Congress, we've doubled down on our belief in grassroots organizing. More than 90% of our support comes from small-dollar donors. (Our opponent? Less than four percent. )

As corporate dark money interests attacked me, distorted my record, and at times outright lied about me, we stood together. Firm in refusing corporate PAC money and we kept pushing for fairness and transparency in our elections.

When the Supreme Court dismantled reproductive freedom and overturned Roe v. Wade , our movement rallied, raising money to elect pro-choice candidates and support activism.

Despite unprecedented dangerous attacks on our democracy itself, this movement has shown – over and over – that there's no remedy more effective than a group of passionate people willing to choose and work for a better future.

We'll be fanning out throughout the district today, knocking on doors and getting out the vote. Together, we built a massive, spirited, and engaged grassroots movement and days like today bring out the best in us. And tonight, we'll gather in living rooms, union halls, neighborhood bars, common rooms, and countless other places to watch the vote tally.

We'll hope for good news, but whatever happens, we know that we worked as hard as we could and maintained our integrity in this race.

So, thank you. I'm so proud of what we've accomplished together so far, and I'm honored to stand at your side in the fight for a just and fair future.

Andy

subject: Get out the vote!
body:
Today is the day: Vote Michael Peroutka for Attorney General of Maryland!
|
---
**Ok it’s go time, warriors! ** **Remember to vote later in the day if possible and to vote using paper, no touch screen voting. Demand paper even if they tell you they ran out. Call the hotline at the bottom of this page if you run into a problem. Have fun standing in line, and bundle up, it’s supposed to be chilly tomorrow. Hey- begin singing "God Bless America" in line and see if you start a trend.....send us a video if you do. Stand tall and proud and fight for our freedom that has so wrongly been taken away from us. Please read through the tips of suspicious activity to be on the lookout for and please call the hotline if you see or hear ANYTHING fraudulent.** **Remind conservative friends and relatives who may not go vote, how important it is for them to go out and vote!** ** ****A helpful tips:**
* voters ensure that you have, or are provided with, BLACK INK pens to mark your paper ballots.
* * voters take your sample ballot with you so you can show that BLACK INK is REQUIRED.
* * we don’t want to give them a reason to invalidate our paper ballots.

A report has come in that an election worker would not let a voter use her black pen to vote in the primaries and gave her a BLUE INK PEN. IT IS NOT TOO LATE TO BE A POLL WATCHER! PLEASE LET US KNOW IF YOU CHANGE YOUR MIND. WE JUST NEED OUR PRESENCE AT THE POLLS; IT’S EASY TO DO AND EXTREMLY IMPORTANT. **BE VIGILANT AND REPORT ANY. SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY:**
* Voter being informed they requested a mail in ballot but claim they did not request a mail in ballot
* Voter showing up to vote in person and being told they must vote provisionally due to some mistake or clerical error made by the BOE
* Busses dropping off unusual groupings of people often with a guide or instructor
* Any voter blocking, intimidation, or fraternizing
* Machinery failure or malfunctions
* How staff and/or officials act towards each other if they’re being suspicious
* People providing names or info to voters who say they “forgot”
* Voting location not opening on time or closing early
* Electioneering taking place too close to the polling location or inside
* Opposing party challengers improperly helping voters with their ballot. There are judges who are there to handle this properly. You can hold the judges in account also!
* A Poll Worker or Presiding Judge leaves the polling site before counts are verified
* The counts of the computers don’t match the counts on the tabulators
* Someone trying to drop off multiple absentee ballots
* Make sure the seal and tamper tape numbers match
* Challenge a voter if you know they aren’t who they say they are! _Example: Your neighbor walks in and gives a false name....._
* Watch for judges not posting the tally at the end of the night. It must stay up until everyone (including judges) have left the poll location

THESE ARE JUST EXAMPLES AND NOT AN EXTENSIVE LIST. _PLEASE, report anything you see that seems off and allow the attorneys to decide what’s important and what’s not. Something that might seem like a minor issue to you, the attorneys might find very helpful, so it’s always better to record all questionable actions!_ **ATTORNEY HOTLINE: ****(410) 210-4450 ** **_(leave a message and someone will get back to within the hour)_** Thank each and every one of you for taking a stand against the evil we are fighting. May God grant Michael and every God-following candidate victory! **FLOOD THE POLLS, MARYLAND!!!** Macky Stafford Campaign Coordinator, Peroutka for Attorney General, State of Maryland 410-336-9894 [Patriots4Peroutka.com](https://d2C1H704.na1.hubspotlinksstarter.com/Ctc/L0+113/d2C1H704/VWRdYv2996f4W6qrHpB4VpYDRW4zFhY94S6tn9N4Tr4MJ3lSbtV1-WJV7CgJM5W4NvcPr5ZsLnPW2Fw6d11VbRtjW7qwYk21xT1C0W3XWhpT3KXzSWN6wVL_KX-BzRVdyMJK7qzTjBW2tprRX6lnVp3W4nbYDq2z8Z0jW6yf5QS2Qm97jVPfSZ717WTh0N8cFmFyyD38NW1BWlWB2wVkp0LTW852wxhyW3hTPLs10hz-_VCFlWR4S1rCGW8T-CpV296VGLN83WbHSnmgkNW4KbVtg3mh7MkVw0F1h5LWgvGW5Pl1gz1BsWTq39Jv1)

clean_body: Today is the day: Vote Michael Peroutka for Attorney General of Maryland! | Ok it’s go time, warriors! Remember to vote later in the day if possible and to vote using paper, no touch screen voting. Demand paper even if they tell you they ran out. Call the hotline at the bottom of this page if you run into a problem. Have fun standing in line, and bundle up, it’s supposed to be chilly tomorrow. Hey- begin singing "God Bless America" in line and see if you start a trend.....send us a video if you do. Stand tall and proud and fight for our freedom that has so wrongly been taken away from us. Please read through the tips of suspicious activity to be on the lookout for and please call the hotline if you see or hear ANYTHING fraudulent. Remind conservative friends and relatives who may not go vote, how important it is for them to go out and vote! A helpful tips: voters ensure that you have, or are provided with, BLACK INK pens to mark your paper ballots. voters take your sample ballot with you so you can show that BLACK INK is REQUIRED. we don’t want to give them a reason to invalidate our paper ballots. A report has come in that an election worker would not let a voter use her black pen to vote in the primaries and gave her a BLUE INK PEN. IT IS NOT TOO LATE TO BE A POLL WATCHER! PLEASE LET US KNOW IF YOU CHANGE YOUR MIND. WE JUST NEED OUR PRESENCE AT THE POLLS; IT’S EASY TO DO AND EXTREMLY IMPORTANT. BE VIGILANT AND REPORT ANY. SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY: Voter being informed they requested a mail in ballot but claim they did not request a mail in ballot Voter showing up to vote in person and being told they must vote provisionally due to some mistake or clerical error made by the BOE Busses dropping off unusual groupings of people often with a guide or instructor Any voter blocking, intimidation, or fraternizing Machinery failure or malfunctions How staff and/or officials act towards each other if they’re being suspicious People providing names or info to voters who say they “forgot” Voting location not opening on time or closing early Electioneering taking place too close to the polling location or inside Opposing party challengers improperly helping voters with their ballot. There are judges who are there to handle this properly. You can hold the judges in account also! A Poll Worker or Presiding Judge leaves the polling site before counts are verified The counts of the computers don’t match the counts on the tabulators Someone trying to drop off multiple absentee ballots Make sure the seal and tamper tape numbers match Challenge a voter if you know they aren’t who they say they are! Example: Your neighbor walks in and gives a false name..... Watch for judges not posting the tally at the end of the night. It must stay up until everyone (including judges) have left the poll location THESE ARE JUST EXAMPLES AND NOT AN EXTENSIVE LIST. PLEASE, report anything you see that seems off and allow the attorneys to decide what’s important and what’s not. Something that might seem like a minor issue to you, the attorneys might find very helpful, so it’s always better to record all questionable actions! ATTORNEY HOTLINE: **(410) 210-4450 (leave a message and someone will get back to within the hour) Thank each and every one of you for taking a stand against the evil we are fighting. May God grant Michael and every God-following candidate victory! FLOOD THE POLLS, MARYLAND!!! Macky Stafford Campaign Coordinator, Peroutka for Attorney General, State of Maryland 410-336-9894 | | | | | Patriots 4 Peroutka, 151 Longfellow Drive, Millersville, MD 21108

body:
How are you? It’s been a whirlwind of an election year and Election Day is finally here. Polls are open across Connecticut so I wanted to take a moment to thank YOU for being in this with me through everything. My second term brought challenges and progress that I could not have imagined – but through it all, YOU held me down and lifted me up. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54282677/378014984/-1295403277?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NDBjYjU3NC02OTVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YdFtwk22mZB7EcJ7kvCl4LR4WL-j0GdQvokQTwmantU=&emci=78919927-b35e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=640cb574-695f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=15529135) | How are you? It’s been a whirlwind of an election year and Election Day is finally here. Polls are open across Connecticut so I wanted to take a moment to thank YOU for being in this with me through everything. My second term brought challenges and progress that I could not have imagined – but through it all, YOU held me down and lifted me up. I know my team has been emailing you a lot these last few weeks. But consider this: Soon the emails will stop, soon the die will be cast, and we’ll just be left with the results. _**I don’t want to leave anything on the field.**_ The truth is, we are a team. It might be my name on the ballot, but I wouldn’t have a chance without supporters like you. I am consistently inspired by Connecticut families, and in turn, you provide the grassroots support I need to fight for you in the halls of Congress. It’s been a long fight, but we can’t tap out now. _There’s simply too much at stake_. We have to protect women’s autonomy over their own bodies, we have to fight tooth and nail to defend Social Security and Medicare, we have to fight to ensure American get the affordable health care they need. **These are the stakes. The House Majority is in _your_ hands. **When the emails finally stop, make sure you are happy with the results. Make sure you did everything you could. I am so grateful for the goodness in people. Thank you for believing in my positive, inspirational and aspirational message. THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU! Now, go vote (if you haven’t already)! name: Michael Bennet (sent from my iPhone)
subject: I have one final request before voting ends tonight
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bennet for Colorado
body:
| Hi folks: I’m about to head out to talk with voters and volunteers across Colorado before voting ends at 7 PM, but before I get in the car, I wanted to reach out to say thank you. # HOW TO FILL OUT A RANKED CHOICE VOTING BALLOT
If you are told by a town clerk or any election official that filling out an RCV ballot across all three columns invalidates your ballot, please call Maine GOP Election Integrity Call Center Immediately**at (207) 610-7826.****Also, you can report your concerns at this link:**[**MAINE - PROTECT THE VOTE**](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=504c088074&e=f8a0a76a2b)**Please note: The instructions on your ballot will advise you to “fill in no more than one oval for each candidate or column.” HOWEVER, this DOES NOT invalidate your ballot. We advise you to fill in all three ovals in Ed’s column.**[**CLICK this LINK for an INSTRUCTIONAL PDF by the Maine Secretary of State’s Office on how to properly fill out an RCV Ballot.**](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=2ff4b8abd1&e=f8a0a76a2b)****

Peter, THIS IS IT! Election Day is finally here and it's time for you to decide whether you want to go down in the history books as a hero... or a bystander.

_Joe Biden 's reckless policies have destroyed our economy, crushed the American energy sector, undermined the quality of our kids' education, and opened our border to a flood of illegal immigration... EVERYTHING is on the chopping block as you read this final email._
Republicans will be forced to wave the white flag unless we can rally a last-minute surge of donations before the polls close TONIGHT. For America,
Republican Leadership Notifications

[_**Derek, I’ll be honest: This is a long email. It’s Election Day, and I know waiting for the results can be stressful. Let’s win this!
Heidi

body:
| [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61081092:WXYLPjDTN:m:1:1405944196:FFD1887898DB539753D8E88E40C1925C:r)
---
| | **George and Barbara Bush belonged to and were active members of a Houston church for more than 50 years. The rector of that church, Reverend Russell Jones Levenson, Jr., believes he was invited into private moments with these public individuals so he could serve as a witness: a witness to observe, and a witness to tell.** [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61081093:WXYLPjDTN:m:1:1405944196:FFD1887898DB539753D8E88E40C1925C:r) [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61081092:WXYLPjDTN:m:1:1405944196:FFD1887898DB539753D8E88E40C1925C:r) With never-before shared correspondence, experiences, and personal stories, Levenson offers new insight into the Bushes' wit and wisdom; their commitment to family and friends; their tireless desire to bless the lives of others; and their steadfast loyalty to their church, their faith, and their God. Before embarking on writing this book on faith, Levenson sought and received the blessing of all the Bush children, including the 43rd president. This book is for readers who yearn for our public officials to serve with faith and integrity like the Bushes. But above all else, this book shows how powerful it is when world leaders are humbled before the power that rests above all powers. [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61081092:WXYLPjDTN:m:1:1405944196:FFD1887898DB539753D8E88E40C1925C:r) MEET THE AUTHOR [](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61081092:WXYLPjDTN:m:1:1405944196:FFD1887898DB539753D8E88E40C1925C:r)Reverend Russell J. Levenson, Jr. lives in Houston, Texas, where he has served as Rector of St. Martin's Episcopal Church since 2007. With nearly 10,000 members, St. Martin's is the largest Episcopal Church in North America. Levenson co-officiated and offered a homily at the state funeral for President George H.W. Bush in Washington, D.C. and in Houston. He also officiated and preached at the funeral for First Lady Barbara Bush in Houston. Levenson has been ordained for 30 years and is the author of several devotional books.

Tony Vargas is a State Senator, public school teacher, and Dad running to represent Nebraska’s Second Congressional District and unseat Republican Don Bacon.

This fight is personal. The American Dream made Tony’s story possible. He refuses to sit on the sidelines while others struggle to achieve the same dream.

This fight is also high stakes. Joe Biden won the presidency because of Nebraska. Now, Tony’s fighting to finish what he started and flip this district blue.

Tony is proud to be endorsed by Planned Parenthood, League of Conservation Voters, 314 Action Fund, BOLD Democrats, Latino Victory Fund, DCCC's Red to Blue Program, and the Nebraska State AFL-CIO.

subject: Election Day Voters - Let's Go Vote!
body:
| | | Hi there, Today is Election Day! I will keep this short and to the point. If you are an Election Day voter like me, then you have two options for getting in your ballot today. Option one – **mail it!** You don’t even need a stamp, just **make sure your ballot is postmarked today.** Option two – **drop off your ballot at an official drop box by 8pm tonight!** **[Find your nearest drop box here.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54296490/378070942/719410068?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjdjMGIwMDNhLTdhNWYtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0rH_ij3A2WZu6T33ZU5Akz8zg0KV667ZJ91lmBol-MY=&emci=f00188ef-f85e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=7c0b003a-7a5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2107230)** When filling out your ballot, make sure to **[check out OLCV’s endorsements.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54296492/378070944/-466892316?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjdjMGIwMDNhLTdhNWYtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0rH_ij3A2WZu6T33ZU5Akz8zg0KV667ZJ91lmBol-MY=&emci=f00188ef-f85e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=7c0b003a-7a5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2107230)** These are the candidates who will prioritize climate action and protect what we love about Oregon for future generations. Your vote will help ensure we elect climate champions to every level of office – from governor to the state legislature to local government. As you know, **the governor’s race is a dead heat, and the future of climate action in Oregon depends on who shows up to vote in this election.** So, let’s show up and vote for Tina Kotek! If you have already mailed or dropped off your ballot, then today is the day we need your help to make sure your friends and family are good voters as well. Right now, **can you take a minute to call or text three friends or family members and remind them to return their ballot today? ** Now, I am off for my favorite part of Election Day – taking my dog Luna for a walk to drop off my ballot at my local library’s ballot drop box. I know I am not the only one who loves voting on Election Day. I am always encouraged by all the others I see walking up to drop off their ballot, too. For all the Election Day voters, let’s go make our votes count! Thanks for being a climate voter! Lindsey Scholten
Deputy Director, OLCV. P.S. If you need additional information about voting in Oregon, you can visit: **[Oregonvotes.gov](https://click.everyaction.com/k/54296494/378070946/-357076319?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjdjMGIwMDNhLTdhNWYtZWQxMS04MTljLTAwMjI0ODI1OGQyZiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=0rH_ij3A2WZu6T33ZU5Akz8zg0KV667ZJ91lmBol-MY=&emci=f00188ef-f85e-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=7c0b003a-7a5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=2107230)** |

_**" WHERE THERE IS NO VISION, THE PEOPLE PERISH..." **__**--**__**PROVERBS 29:18**_
The uniquely American idea that all men are created equal and endowed by their Creator with unalienable rights to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness - American Freedom - has created, by any measure, the greatest and most prosperous country in the history of the world.

**Unfortunately, over many decades, liberal policies have created one disaster after another.**

_Currently, our borders are under siege, our citizens have been betrayed, our allies have been abandoned, our currency has been debased through inflation, our schools have been transformed into indoctrination centers, our energy independence has been sacrificed on the altar of climate alarmism, and**our great economy has been brought to a screeching halt by the radical Leftʼs big-government socialism. **_

When patriotic Americans dare to stand for freedom, justice, and truth, the Left uses racial attacks to silence them and _eventually erase them from public life._

The U.S. Constitution begins with "We the People," and We the People have had _**enough**_ of these destructive policies. We must return to the pro-freedom policies of the Trump-Pence administration. Together, we can advance American culture, American opportunity, American leadership, and ultimately _**[Advance American Freedom once again.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61822908:JL3jgkGNh:m:1:3331421248:22EE7EB607DBBD2D8121E5B0FD168289:r "Advance American
Freedom once again.")**_

**" It was freedom, not socialism, that gave us the most prosperous economy in human history.

It was freedom, not socialism, that ended slavery, won two world wars and that stands as a beacon of hope for all the world." **

_- Vice President Mike Pence_
