> _We thought you might want to see this special message from our friends at Republican Accountability PAC._
Friend,

As Americans across the country turn out to vote, I just wanted to take a moment to thank all of you for supporting Republican Accountability PAC this cycle. You know the threat posed by extreme candidates like Kari Lake, J.D. Vance, Herschel Walker, and countless other Trump loyalists on the ballot today. For months, we’ve been hard at work getting the message out that Republicans, former Republicans, and conservatives like you could never vote for these extremists. And it’s your voices that are going to be on voters’ minds as they go to the polls. Now it’s up to them to make their choices. **Regardless of what happens tonight, the threats to our democracy will still need to be confronted.** I know I can count on you to continue to help us work to defeat candidates who want to overturn elections and spread conspiracy theories. But for now, let’s reflect on all the hard work we did this election cycle. There’s a tough road ahead, and I’m glad to have your support as we continue fighting for our democracy. Sarah Longwell Treasurer, Republican Accountability PAC

I'm bumping my message from yesterday to remind you to **get those ballots in!** I've always said Central Washington is BLUE, but only if we all make our voices heard.

[Get all the information you need to return your ballot before 8 p.m. by clicking here.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54300041/378086016/1154851129?refcode=DW_EM_GOTV_WL_221108_1_1&refcode2=d782b27d-805f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&contactdata=J8260BHukAOxC%2BF6DEU6lyoe7LP8rMDpyenZg6RXRW7PI5HBMBYiLxpaWO%2FPFnCw&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNzgyYjI3ZC04MDVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b4Zk1Cxt6xITlbQBgIhudktV18AnjVhXPkRDgmUuw0E=&emci=8e10fd99-7c5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=d782b27d-805f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=7651992)

Doug

**_Original message from Doug White sent Monday, November 8:_**

As voting in our crucial midterm election comes to a close, I want to lay out the stakes of our race here in WA-04 and remind you to [return your ballot by 8 p.m. on Election Day.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54300042/378086017/1154851129?refcode=DW_EM_GOTV_WL_221108_1_1&refcode2=d782b27d-805f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&contactdata=J8260BHukAOxC%2BF6DEU6lyoe7LP8rMDpyenZg6RXRW7PI5HBMBYiLxpaWO%2FPFnCw&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNzgyYjI3ZC04MDVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=b4Zk1Cxt6xITlbQBgIhudktV18AnjVhXPkRDgmUuw0E=&emci=8e10fd99-7c5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=d782b27d-805f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=7651992)

Since launching my campaign last year, I’ve traveled to every corner of our district, and everywhere I go I hear the same thing – from small business owners, farm workers, parents, you name it:

**Nothing ever changes.**

After decades of the same kind of leadership in Congress, we’ve made almost no investment in drought resilience, our immigration system is absolutely broken, and our infrastructure is crumbling underneath us. **It’s time for a change.**

Together, I know we can make our community a better place to live.

We know what problems we need to address – they’re the same problems we’ve had for decades that never get fixed.

Newhouse has become a shill for the new Republican party, more interested in power and control than traditional Republicans. He’s lost sight of the fact that **Congress works for the people – not the other way around.**

So I’m asking you: **Can I count on your vote?**

**Our future is in your hands, so I have two requests for you:**
1. **Get yourself together, fill out your ballot, and vote!**

Our win depends on voter turnout. Central Washington is blue! Sitting out is not an option in this election.

With your help (and your vote), we WILL win!

Thank you,

Doug

body:

Email from SOTS Office Saying Results of Election Could be delayed.

Dear ,

Election Day is upon us, and I am sure you are being overwhelmed with political texts, emails, and phone calls—so this will be one of my final appeals to you.

As a lifelong resident of New Haven county, Pop Warner football coach for 32 years, and a successful businessman—you can trust me to make our elections safe, secure, and accessible.

To watch my television ads, click here (https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=3251e52048&e=8763c56857) .

To read my position papers and plans for when I become Secretary of the State, click here (https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=165d6e82c5&e=8763c56857) .

Don’t sit this one out—your vote makes a difference!

Thank you for all of your support over the past 18 months—I couldn’t have gotten here without you.

God bless you and God bless the great state of Connecticut,

Dominic Rapini

Republican Candidate for Secretary of the State

# It's Election Day! Get Out And Vote!
## Take a friend or family member to the polls and Vote Nancy Mace!

Friends and supporters,

It's Election Day, and I need your help.

Two years ago nobody thought we could win this seat back, but together we did it.

This is still a swing district, the polls have tightened, but all we need to do to win is get out the vote!

## Check Out My Final TV Ad
If you haven't seen my latest ad, check it out on [YouTube](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=5adccc6976&e=ddc57b5ede).

[](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=556a4030a9&e=ddc57b5ede)
##
The Choice Is Clear

My opponent tries to hide it, but she is 100% woke and a "very left leaning" activist, who:
* Pledged to vote for Biden in 2024!
* Refused to defend Parris Island from closure at our debate.
* Supported Biden's massive spending bills that caused inflation
* Opposed a bill that would ban sex change surgery, castration and permanent gender-changing hormones on our kids
* Is a woke activist who once said one of her top priorities were gender pronouns
* Donated to a group that created the "defund the police" movement
* Is a part of Indivisible - a radical organization that believes in defunding the police, Border Patrol and ICE

The list could go on forever, but one thing is for sure: A _nnie Andrews is too woke_ and _too radical for the Lowcountry_.

## Make Your Voice Heard
We are not going to let this seat fall into the hands of a radical like Annie Andrews, but we can't take this swing district for granted, no matter how bad Joe Biden's approval ratings.

Tomorrow we are going to kick off the Red Wave in our district.

All we need to do is vote. Reach out to your friends and family, tell them to vote Mace, and we will keep the Lowcountry from falling back into the hands of the party if inflation, crime and illegal immigration.
Sincerely,
Rep. Nancy Mace

P.S. If you have any questions about voting, email the campaign at campaign@nancymace.org, and someone will reach out to help.

| | Peter,
It’s time to stop asking, **_“What caused the gas crisis?”_** and start asking, **_“Who caused the gas crisis?” _** Because that question has a simple answer: Joe Biden.
---
[**END JOE BIDEN’S GAS CRISIS NOW**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a375abc012e4e7ca456c35b4dac9f1d&_e=lU60-xvMNR1MMUKUepp2asQvfzufEr0KQlNzRo23jBw_ScItSuOZ-uem3_flx24U6xl8pzaljjni6gEIJkKYzkrjZ4z0_9Fvyq4Y3QCmB9Oav-s3e2DWwmXQmKgHl00_CTjnYYheCOPJ86-9-OMyv_G_8Y11sgYvDuIC-h9nhPFy-rGRjj40ctdsyTNGmy_IaPpMeWmve8KCwitLu2AeVbIy0DYsDkfN6sT68_fxSsrWey23NmRIRuPv3jhoVnm1hh4-4FEFmD0dLi827WW5qVImJRTW6r4QI0cl49Z9k4kU5pNFOJbPRzW4VMiqbJp-aD9_4u7K2GdPcaI4_oWN-er3S2KIQC4H_y9yzmgt7WYOjfJV9aX1om_wKClUlnuz9_MC-uxvOuatSR5Jx2X70Q%3D%3D)
---
Here’s what Joe Biden did:
1. He **SHUT DOWN the Keystone Pipeline** — cowing to the radical green agenda and dramatically increasing our dependence on Russian oil...

2. He**SHUT DOWN critical energy exploration** on American soil wherever he could...

3. And then, when the crisis hit us hardest, he tapped into our strategic oil reserves...** _and sent it to Communist China instead of the American people!_**

No wonder you’ve been feeling the pain at the pump! **Every single one of these actions was a deliberate, preventable policy mistake by Joe Biden and the radical Left.** Peter, we CAN put a stop to this. **Advancing American Freedom, the policy organization I founded to help us return to the pro-America policies of the Trump/Pence Administration, has** _[**the plan to unleash American energy and reverse this crisis.****.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a375abc012e4e7ca456c35b4dac9f1d&_e=lU60-xvMNR1MMUKUepp2asQvfzufEr0KQlNzRo23jBw_ScItSuOZ-uem3_flx24U6xl8pzaljjni6gEIJkKYzkrjZ4z0_9Fvyq4Y3QCmB9Oav-s3e2DWwmXQmKgHl00_CTjnYYheCOPJ86-9-OMyv_G_8Y11sgYvDuIC-h9nhPFy-rGRjj40ctdsyTNGmy_IaPpMeWmve8KCwitLu2AeVbIy0DYsDkfN6sT68_fxSsopDgHzTz5isg5uT-LZJghJd4iFIZOj6aXNHUwXuKPSzjuPEyCsX_252TCKcl47hchf0wiArlEyYaQmyEBGMCv9tgj6jVoZIHdAfTWvNsCJml9VC95SQbnnZV3DNc3lNOZc0eo_pfgXKOG21LkRzdD9I0zfvjBd4Tir3NNhf6EE1g%3D%3D)_ This plan won’t just lower gas prices. It will:
* Decrease energy bills
* Create good-paying American jobs
* And strengthen our national security by declaring our energy independence.

It’s such a simple, commonsense plan, Peter. And we have the know-how to make it actually happen in Washington. But I need your support to let our leaders know just how urgent this is. **Can I count on you, Peter?**
---
[**YES, I WANT AMERICA TO BE ENERGY INDEPENDENT AGAIN!**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a375abc012e4e7ca456c35b4dac9f1d&_e=lU60-xvMNR1MMUKUepp2asQvfzufEr0KQlNzRo23jBw_ScItSuOZ-uem3_flx24U6xl8pzaljjni6gEIJkKYzkrjZ4z0_9Fvyq4Y3QCmB9Oav-s3e2DWwmXQmKgHl00_CTjnYYheCOPJ86-9-OMyv_G_8Y11sgYvDuIC-h9nhPFy-rGRjj40ctdsyTNGmy_IaPpMeWmve8KCwitLu2AeVbIy0DYsDkfN6sT68_fxSsr04EJ5F1rCGn_HNy4ewXl5eB2oXehSS_ee5WGONjfpK7BX4lBpf2Yhfh9_V1Y_cFSk-KUlmdBeaoiT--k2cm-jMv7iZZeb-nW-aNlCXxxIYhDxWAaxHs0WagQrbD6tKFC4bfuyP2kA8oFQyc3YykKwNn2qtKncZrcF4vCZv2PZAA%3D%3D)

Good morning friends! This is it: Election Day is TODAY in PA-17 and the polls are now OPEN (from 7am to 8pm)!I’m already out at the polls greeting | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jeremyshaffer/vote118?e=32107e7cf1)
---
| |

| | Good morning friends!

This is it: **Election Day is TODAY and the polls are now OPEN (from 7am to 8pm)!**

I’m already out at the polls greeting voters and I'll be spending the entire day rallying our supporters across District 17 to VOTE and get out their family and friends.

**Please forward this email to 5 people you know to remind them to vote!**

If you or anyone you know needs help getting to the polls, please let me know - we can help!

I've been so encouraged by all the support we've received - and I couldn't be more proud of everything we've accomplished together.

While this may be the last day of the campaign, it is only the beginning.

Because when you go to the polls today and elect me to the U.S. House, I will continue to gather with you any time, any place to discuss the problems our communities face and come up with solutions together.

We are neck and neck in this race and I am asking you to work hard with me until the polls close at 8pm.

Thank you for your vote, your support, and your prayers. We wouldn’t be here today without you.

Now let's go win this!

With gratitude,
Jeremy Shaffer

P.S. - we have volunteers helping us with poll-greeting around the district today. If you have an hour or two to help out, reach out to Devin via call/text (419-344-6210) and he'll let you know where to go.

P.P.S. - after polls close at 8pm, join us The DoubleTree in Green Tree to watch election results come in!
**THANK YOU!**

chance to flip a Senate seat and add a powerful progressive voice to

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/3202?source=OR_EM_GOTV_30SP_20221108_1_1&t=1010&akid=3659%2E5885482%2EDy_Lgz ]Click HERE to find your polling place!

Summer Lee for U.S. House of Representatives (PA-12)

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/3202?source=OR_EM_GOTV_30SP_20221108_1_1&t=1011&akid=3659%2E5885482%2EDy_Lgz ][IMG]

Polls are uncomfortably close between John - an authentic Pennsylvanian
who will fight for all of us - and Dr. Oz, an elitist hack who just wants
power for a rightwing takeover of the Senate.

That’s why Our Revolution is carrying out a massive GOTV operation to make
sure we flip this seat and elect a progressive to the Senate.

John Fetterman will fight for higher wages, abortion rights, and the union
way of life. He’s committed to codifying Roe v. Wade and making more stuff
in America to bring down costs, and he will be a strong ally for our
movement.

We have a chance to hold off a MAGA Majority and grow the Senate majority
- so we can diminish the power of corporate Dems like Manchin and Sinema
and build on our work rather than play defense under rightwing rule.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/3202?source=OR_EM_GOTV_30SP_20221108_1_1&t=1012&akid=3659%2E5885482%2EDy_Lgz ][IMG]

With our support, Summer Lee beat a corporatist Dem in this year’s primary
in Pennsylvania’s 12th Congressional District! Now it’s time to win the
general election.

Currently serving in the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, Summer Lee
previously was a labor organizer in the Fight for $15 and to protect and
enhance all workers rights. She also led voter mobilization efforts to
increase participation in our democracy.

In 2018, Summer made history as the first Black woman from Western
Pennsylvania elected to the state legislature. Throughout her time in
office, Summer has been a voice for working families and an ally of Our
Revolution.

In Congress, she’ll champion Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and
voting rights. She will challenge corporate power and fight to restore the
voice of her Western PA constituents and reclaim democracy.

Summer is proud to count Bernie Sanders as one of her staunch supporters.
Electing the progressive Summer Lee is how we rebuild Congress from
corporate elites and make Washington work for all of us.

With polls this tight, every vote counts! This election is an opportunity
to defeat the far right, elect progressives, and shift the political
landscape so we can build on our work rather than playing defense under
rightwing rule.

Thank you for being active in the political process - and encouraging your
friends and family to get out to vote, too!

When we organize, we win,

Our Revolution

As the commander of military forces in East Africa, I asked the American Forces Network to replace Fox News during meal hours for troops. Why? Because they were harmful to America's outreach overseas. They put our troops in jeopardy and made my job harder. Today, they have accomplices.

Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. **My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.**

Hey Team,
We live in dangerous times. The world is on the brink of CHAOS, and this election will make a HUGE difference in how our world looks in 2024. I want you to close your eyes and think of the future you want in the next 2 years. Do you want it to be a world where women’s rights are set back GENERATIONS, erasing DECADES of protest and struggle? Do you want it to be one where the money you put towards your retirement VANISHES, dissolving your LIFETIME of hard work? Do you want it to be one where you are THREATENED AND ATTACKED just for voting Democrat? Or do you want it to be one where leaders expand on the freedoms you already enjoy? Where the free marketplace of ideas is strengthened, and we can return to healthy debate and discourse? Where a work-life balance is possible again?
Jim Jordan wants a world of CHAOS. He wants an oligarchy where the powerful do what they please, and everyone else suffers what they must. That’s because he is one of the powerful few. He is not and never will be one of us. He cares about rubbing shoulders with billionaires and high-profile politicians, like Donald Trump, who could not be more out of touch with everyday Americans. I am committed to upholding our Democracy and American values: that anyone can succeed, everyone enjoys the same rights, and politicians can be held accountable. As the world teeters towards chaos, it is our job to pull it back to stable ground. We have to send a message to Jim Jordan and his buddies that we REJECT their fear-mongering, their tyranny, and their indifference to our suffering.
Polls in Ohio close in 7 hours and 30 minutes. That is all we have left to get the word out about how awful Jim Jordan really is. It may not seem like a lot, but we can catch people before before they get off work and head to the polls. Please help me get one last message out before the last big wave of voters head to the polls, and help me take down Jim Jordan once and for all. I’m humbly asking one last time for $25, $50, $100, $500, $1,000 or even $2,900 to pull the world back onto stable ground.
Thanks,
Tamie

| Hi ,

Today is the day we unite under one mission to restore the Californian dream!

But this is URGENT - the turnout of voters is at a record LOW!

Have you voted yet?

Low voter turnout **also means that Newsom’s base is not showing up to vote!**

This is our chance!

Can I count on you to show up, to call all your family to show up, and to urge your friends to do the same?

This will come down to every single vote cast, and our state cannot endure another four years of Newsom’s failed leadership.

\- Senator Brian Dahle

Hey team — I’m reaching out one last time before the polls close.
At the start of this campaign, Dr. Kermit decided not to accept corporate PAC money, knowing it would hurt our fundraising efforts. body:
I want to thank everyone who signed the card wishing me a happy birthday and good luck in the election today.
| | | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00159NmUuQF_5xVPlSfklk_AKy6rFyOga8BrnOVT8i9riIn7-Qzvn6_uI4M7bM9m9rT7lJDTnsg1R2S0KxGFniDC0AbYnrWe8yZxzBfymgRjCEhbt8hXHHTsn3wx60NHxStsG4FYWhCVohEQlRnapLuuOqYwTdcPXcvbSy0Mwedam-IkieeJEERAQ5VwHXEZCIgfZrGQNkrH9IwU66dxoxjvxyx6wOUv1Ejl3w9-PihpZY=&c=fgzVvzish9zzub8334c0LYB40BDQCgBpY3YYnAEbSg-Sz2H4gTPN9A==&ch=d7rDlgzFUmPKlVvEixYTy89Bem6JQJA6pnoSwUyJsuVnGoMUJec68w==)

| Peter,
I want to thank everyone who signed the card wishing me a happy birthday and good luck in the election today.
Gestures like that are why I always like to take pictures of the crowd on all of my campaign stops: it reminds me of what our mission is all about...

Team,

Good morning, and Happy Election Day! Polls are open here in Wisconsin from 7am to 8pm this evening.

It can be easy to forget with all the muck flying around, but voting is an aspirational act. It expresses our hope and desire that our community can be better, the future brighter, but only if we vote for the people who will reject fear and division and work together to move us forward.

I believe those candidates include Governor Tony Evers, Lt. Gov Mandela Barnes (Candidate for US Senate), Attorney General Josh Kaul, Democrats running for State Senate and Assembly, and of course, my good friend State Sen. Brad Pfaff, who is running for Congress. I urge you to consider their candidacies today and vote to continue their service to our state and country.

Please check your polling location by visiting myvote.wi.gov. Make sure to connect with your friends and family and make sure they have their plan to vote in place.

Happy voting! Take good care.

Ron Kind

| | Friend,**

**GOOD MORNING, KANSAS! Election Day is finally upon us. I’m reaching out today with two simple messages for you:

1\. **_If you or any of your friends or family have NOT VOTED YET, be SURE to find your closest polling location and GET OUT THE VOTE for Team Schmidt!_

** State law requires polling locations to **open at 7:00 AM** and **close at 7:00 PM CT** on Election Day. Find your closest polling location here: [https://myvoteinfo.voteks.org/VoterView](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=46b337e0966c4df9ad5ad06ee534bc48&_e=4oxoTw-h-nDwWvn-xW0t4tUDu76akwIoQSVEvTLGp1iIf3PUOv52-KuquHJCcBlrq6vM9-LbXzpOA1t-nOMigWNYj3LpqlvTF9PmAVocyf8lp8ec2fNoyAuLgRSx1XsUlM1UIMPeU7cCCiv0oXBvu-Un1R2LaZQJBR1FKh7ko_V6KWaGrZhVqNrJWzbxZjcc979KRK9RZQQwHlUcY11v7xiZlJDF4QRwB_fCIn_XxWk%3D)

THE POLLS ARE OPEN! We need YOU to vote >> | |
---
| | | Friends,

First things first, I want to thank you. Election day is finally here and we could not have made it to this point without you.

If I could ask you for one more favor, it would be to take your friends and family with you to the polls today.

_**Every single vote makes a difference.**_
---
|
---
| Over the past two years, Democrats in Washington have made it more difficult for families and businesses to succeed across Kansas. Today will be an important step in getting America out of the ditch and back on track to greatness. We simply can't afford another two years of Joe Biden and Nancy Pelosi's one-party rule in Washington.

**Kansans deserve leadership in Congress that works for them–not the other way around. ****When Republicans take back the House, I will fight to lower inflation, secure the border, fund our law enforcement, and give families and businesses the tools they need to succeed.**

I hope I have earned your trust as someone you can depend on to represent our shared values and beliefs in Congress. I humbly ask for your support at the ballot box today.

God bless you and see you at the polls!

Yours in the fight,

Jake LaTurner

Peter, today is the day we’ve been working toward for so many months.

**Election Day is ___finally_ here – and now is the chance to make your voice heard. **
| | [Contribute to my campaign](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54306490/378110825/379053316?&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk864-fr-fl-v2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTg0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzYwZDgyNy04ZjVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_eFThPX8GFNdaTxDG6wHPyqzJA768_748tDWP7w0BcA=)
---
But, even though most polls have already opened, my campaign for re-election isn’t over yet. In these final hours my get-out-the-vote operation is running full steam ahead, and my team _**will not rest**_**** until the final poll closes.

That’s why my team set _one final goal_ to raise $10,000 before polls close to ensure that we can contact every last voter – and I’m counting on your help. Let me explain why losing this race is not an option:

My GOP opponent is not only wrong for New York – he’s also a threat to all of the progress that I have fought so hard to win for working families. body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi Derek, it’s
Stacey Abrams.

I have one final message for you before the polls close for the last time
in this race.

We’re in the final hours of my race before the polls close and the votes
are tallied. No matter what happens, I want to thank you for your support.
Whether you were with me since day one or joined just last week,
grassroots supporters
like you have made this campaign possible.

Together, we have gone to corners of Georgia that politicians have left
behind for decades. We have inspired people in every corner of the state
to ask for more from their leaders — and to fight for what they deserve.
We have made clear that One Georgia — where we all can thrive — is within
reach.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221108_B1_MyFinalAsk_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=18879%2E1862389%2Ex67k4S ]However, with just hours left in this race, anything could happen — and
I need your help to be prepared. So, I want to ask you one final time
before the polls close and millions of eyes across the country are on
Georgia: will you donate $5 or more to my campaign?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221108_B1_MyFinalAsk_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=18879%2E1862389%2Ex67k4S ]DONATE

I ran to embrace a vision of opportunity and success across Georgia — no
matter your background or zip code. I ran for Georgia’s children and our
families. But most importantly, I ran because I saw the harm that Brian
Kemp was inflicting on communities across Georgia, and I have never been
one to run away when I see someone in need of help.

The next Governor of Georgia should be someone who opens up gates of
opportunity and keeps Georgians safe. Someone who’s looking out for every
community — not just the ones that vote for her.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221108_B1_MyFinalAsk_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=18879%2E1862389%2Ex67k4S ]So, before this race is over, I want to ask you to envision a Georgia
where everyone has a chance to make a good living. A Georgia where
everyone has the opportunity to thrive. A Georgia where we don’t live
separate lives, independent of one another, but we are one singular
community striving for more. Where we are One Georgia. Now that you can
picture it, will you donate $5 now to help me reach the
finish line in just a few hours?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/6203?refcode=sa_em_221108_B1_MyFinalAsk_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=18879%2E1862389%2Ex67k4S ]DONATE

What you’ve done for my campaign, and for me, is truly unique. And from
the bottom of my heart: thank you for getting us through this. Now let’s
go make history.

Stacey

body:
I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.
| | |
---
Peter —

I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.

No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.

And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.
National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. **But I refuse to let them win. **

I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — **[will you split a donation of $5 between my campaign and Trudy Busch Valentine if you agree?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54307325/378113250/1068484449?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk443-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZWRiYTZkZi04ZjVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LWA37-C_syo2JYhhXaCL_dFjzry8PVyydRMgYo3nnfM=)**

Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — **[if you agree, will you split a $5 donation between my campaign and Trudy Busch Valentine?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54307326/378113261/1068484449?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk443-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZWRiYTZkZi04ZjVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LWA37-C_syo2JYhhXaCL_dFjzry8PVyydRMgYo3nnfM=)**
Science, data, and facts have helped me solve some of the most difficult challenges in my life. And I think we need more members of Congress who are willing to put politics aside and do the same.

body:
Head to IWillVote.com to find out everything you need to know about casting your ballot in Pennsylvania.
| | | It’s Election Day.

The stakes could not be higher: Whether or not we’re able to continue building a better America depends on our ability to protect our Democratic Senate majority and elect more Democrats at all levels of government.

**It’s critical that you know where and when you can cast a ballot -- and it’s never been easier to get all the information you need to go vote.**

**[Head to IWillVote.com to find out everything you need to know about casting your ballot in Pennsylvania.](https://go.dscc.org/go/10948?t=1&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-ND-20221108-PresidentJosephRBidenJr-BidenSignedGOTV-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-ND-20221108-PresidentJosephRBidenJr-BidenSignedGOTV-Pros-sl1&akid=8553%2E9716520%2EHSDeXE)**

---

If you've already voted, talk with your friends and family -- tell them what this election means to you. Tell them their voice is just as powerful as yours. And tell them that you need them to make their voice heard, too.

Let’s win this together,

Joe

Joseph R. Biden, Jr.
President of the United States

_Have questions about voting? Call the DNC’s voter hotline at 833-336-8683. If you need a text-based alternative, text ACCESS to 43367.

| | | Friend,

Here's the truth, plain and simple: Running a full-fledged campaign to unseat Kansas' LAST Democrat is expensive.

name: Ron Johnson
subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z5fgerm55lkl7bhd1stoh4t6joc6j4dlmke2d268_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37chieiqj6d5jmspqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65t77cdjj0s76chobactkmoorbd5gemp79p5kciq66tb26crb7ddielo6bcphc1rjfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3cup7ephimapm0pti6dj30s5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash1k8gn48n24hhm6pr4spg62pj6c8iv0)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win today if I can count on your support right now.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zl3iuroc3dtrphflei424kajefhfu0o19r1te5qg_rp22sh2s8i66or7cjj60ob6cph2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---
| |
* * *
---
|
---
A note from Ron Johnson: America is in peril. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches: this is a fight for freedom. **This is not someone else’s fight, this is our fight, and it’s a fight we absolutely must win.** As a grandpa, dad, and businessman, I refuse to lose our country to radicals and woke liberals with their socialist agenda. I refuse to jeopardize America's future. I know you feel the same.

_**[**Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z6ke3rjavtd1ierqf046cm1cnfeq4ienn473obq8_rp22sh2s8i66or7cjj60ob6cph2bs "Can I personally ask you to join me in this fight for Freedom, Friend?")**_

**[Can you chip in $5 right now to give our campaign the help we need to counter this last minute attack?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54314033/378121985/-166214855?refcode=nw_em_221108_2_gm&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&amount=5”&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzcxZjJkYi05NjVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x_17BwRtl7DkhQ4_QHo6McOqa0jTZhXQ-XSIYSE8H9M=)**

Nan Whaley

| | | Friends,

Happy Election Day! As you head to the polls, please make note of these important reminders:
* Remember your photo ID
* Return your advance by mail ballot, if you requested one, by the close of polls
* [Preview your ballot](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=777194f6b5&e=e4cd931cf2) and [verify your polling location](https://scottschwab.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=637dedc6f5c04616f44b83bbf&id=a2bb55fa98&e=e4cd931cf2)

This election is so important to the future of our state. We have the opportunity to prove Kansas is a red state and bring common-sense, Republican leadership to every government office in Topeka.

When you head to vote today, I humbly ask for your vote and encourage you to support the Republicans on the ballot.

All my best,

It’s hard to believe that it’s finally Election Day.
I can’t help but to feel incredibly grateful for the support of my family, campaign staff, and you – my supporters. Your support has powered this campaign to levels that I couldn’t have imagined when I first announced that I was running for re-election.
And when the Republican Party announced that they were running one of their most far-right candidates against me, you didn’t hesitate to step up. Every goal that my campaign set wasn’t just reached, you helped us fly past it. **It’s your support that powered this campaign and helped my team organize across all corners of the district.**
Now, as people head to the polls all across NV-03, I want to take a moment to outline the difference between me and my opponent’s visions for the future of our state.
For me, it’s simple. I believe that LGBTQ+ rights must be protected, reproductive freedom is worth fighting for, voting rights are sacred, and we need to put money back in the pockets of working families. This is just the beginning of what I’m prepared to head back to Congress and fight for.
On the other hand, April Becker risks putting our state down a dark path. She’s received endorsements from national anti-choice groups and has gone beyond election denialism – she filed two lawsuits to overturn the results of her State Senate race. _And when she didn’t get her way in court, she vowed to “never run for office again” in Nevada._
This choice in this race is clear and it’s more important than ever that Nevadans have a representative whose priority is serving their constituents, not their own political gain.
**Your vote matters. The future of our country is resting on you today and I hope you’ll make your voice heard.**
Thank you for all that you’ve done to support my campaign.
**Let’s get out there and win!**
Susie Lee

subject: Today, tomorrow, and every day into the future.

body:
The work to defend our democracy continues.
|
---

Friend, With the stakes higher than ever in recent memory, I know it can be nerve wracking to wait around for the results of tonight’s elections. All over the country, races up and down the ballot will have enormous consequences for the future of our rights and our democracy. From state legislators and state supreme court justices to governors and secretaries of state, the officials we elect at the state level tonight will have the power to either protect our democracy or degrade it even further. That's why the NDRC went all out and spared no expense to support nearly 500 Democracy Defenders in key races across the nation. We worked in 17 battleground states to ensure the officials we help elect today will be committed to strengthening our democracy — not subverting it. But we also know that this work is a marathon, not a sprint. **Whether pro-democracy candidates win or lose tonight, we’re still going to have to keep working to stop anti-democratic forces in the Republican Party in 2023 and 2024. They’re not giving up, and neither can we.** | _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

subject: Please vote today — and make sure all of your family and friends turn out as well.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
The polls are open right now all across North Carolina, and I am asking for your vote.
#

Our records indicate you may not live in North Carolina, but we know you may have friends or family in our state. Please forward them this email and encourage them to vote for Cheri!
The day is finally here — Election Day. The polls are open right now all across North Carolina, and I am asking for your vote.
If you did not get a chance to vote early, it’s so important that you make your voice heard today. This is your last chance to cast a vote!
[**Click here to find your polling location and help us flip North Carolina.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2339?t=1&akid=2258%2E357359%2EvMboQH)
**[FIND YOUR POLLING LOCATION](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2339?t=2&akid=2258%2E357359%2EvMboQH)**
We know that this race is in a dead heat. Every single vote is going to count, so I need you to turn out your family, your friends, and every single person you can to make sure that we win.
Polls are open statewide until 7:30 PM, and every voter in line by that time will be allowed to vote!
[**So please click here to find your polling location to cast your ballot today. Your vote is your voice, and it’s so critical that we all make ourselves heard today.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2339?t=3&akid=2258%2E357359%2EvMboQH)
**[FIND YOUR POLLING LOCATION](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2339?t=4&akid=2258%2E357359%2EvMboQH)**
Thank you for being part of this fight with us. I am so honored, and I promise to always put North Carolina’s families first as your next United States Senator.
\- Cheri Beasley
P.S. - Please text your family and friends to vote as well. If you’re on your phone, [**you can click this link to get a pre-filled text message to send to everyone you know.**](sms:&body=Hey! Have you voted yet? Please don't forget! The Senate race is really close in North Carolina, and Cheri Beasley needs your vote. Polls close at 7:30, and you can find your voting location here: IWillVote.com)
**[TEXT YOUR FRIENDS](sms:&body=Hey! Have you voted yet? Please don't forget! The Senate race is really close in North Carolina, and Cheri Beasley needs your vote. Polls close at 7:30, and you can find your voting location here: IWillVote.com)**
If you have time or resources to spare, any last-minute support you can give to boost our campaign would mean a lot.
**[VOLUNTEER](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/5738?tag_ids=212%3Futm_source%3Dem221108-1-ma&t=5&akid=2258%2E357359%2EvMboQH)**

Raleigh, NC 27611

I am absolutely blown away by how Coloradans have SHOWED UP time & time again for what they believe in. Reflecting on all these rallies, I see how our movement grew and gained momentum. One person at a time standing up for their family, their business, their faith, and their freedom and joining our efforts to SAVE Colorado. Enough is enough. It's time to take back our beautiful state tomorrow. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qiltljy-ttjjilthht-y/) [**Click here for a recap of our biggest rallies this year!**](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qiltljy-ttjjilthht-j/) **GET OUT THE VOTE, COLORADO!** Make sure you encourage all of your friends and family to get out and vote tomorrow. Polls are open until 7pm and it's not too late to register. All of your questions can be answered at **[GOVOTECOLORADO.GOV](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qiltljy-ttjjilthht-t/)**!_Worried about election integrity? We need you to vote, or we won 't win. You gave me a platform to use my voice and share my vision. | | | [**WHY DR BOB?**](https://www.votedrbob.com/so/c2OHNPqyR/c?w=opGMk0KIsa-w8qUQY4T097vbgI90wP1oEEegMtxLvTQ.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2ZyaWVuZHMtb2YtZHItYm9iLTEiLCJyIjoiYTk0NDAyMjUtYWQzNS00YWRlLWI4ZjEtYjQyYzAyMjZiMjdhIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiMTg2NjI2ZDUtY2E1ZS00NjMzLTgzNGEtZTg4M2QwYmRkZDc1In0)

| | "I am voting for Dr. Bob Lorinser for Congress because knowing him for a very long time has revealed his true character. I know he actually lives here. I know about his high ethical standards. I know how he has always been a man dedicated to service for others and to something greater than himself. "I know of his intelligence, compassion, balanced wisdom and fearless independence in critical decision making. I know how he speaks truth to power, to oppose bureaucratic bungling. I know how he is always armed with facts, science and compelling logic. "I know we now have a good shot at firing the robot currently holding our congressional seat, and replacing that with a fiercely independent, free thinker, Dr. Bob Lorinser. "Dr. Lorinser and I worked for over 20 years as attending physicians together treating critically ill patients at our regional hospital here in Marquette. He was a doc who was always the patients advocate, possessed great diagnostic ability, and always kept himself up to date with the latest medical science. Indeed, a role model for other physicians. "During my career as an emergency physician, I noticed especially on those ragged, edgy, overwhelming nights when our ER was in crisis mode, how Dr. Bob responded as an efficient, cool-headed team member leading with his heart in service to others. "We also served together on multiple advisory committees providing input based on our clinical experiences to hospital administration on how to improve quality, efficiency and safety of all patient care. Dr. Lorinser courageously resisted and railed against the bureaucracy every time that it threatened the highest standards of any patient’s care. "Dr. Lorinser believes as I do that the physician and patient relationship is a very private and complex sacred space created in service to the patient and insuring the patient’s freedom of choice in medical decisions. The government’s attempt to intrude into this sacred space and remove these freedoms, is them trying to practice medicine without a license or medical education. "Dr. Bob knows the power of public health, and that an ounce of prevention can eliminate many chronic diseases, the suffering that these cause, as well as heading off a huge and growing disease care expense for our country."These are the reasons you should also vote for Bob Lorinser for Congress." — Scott Emerson, Marquette

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Make your voices heard
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=1298%2E5257348%2EDFTfcX ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek —

In every state, every county, and every city around America, today is
Election Day.

Our right to vote is the right upon which all others rest. Our vote
determines who represents us. Our vote determines what laws are passed.
Our vote determines what our country looks like. Not just for us, but for
our children, and our grandchildren. Our vote is sacred.

So it’s worth telling you what I stand for, as I ask for your vote.

I stand for you and working families, not the biggest corporations. I
stand for you and for universal healthcare, not big pharmaceutical
companies. I stand for you and our democracy, not those who seek to take
it away.

I stand for you and the future of our planet, not big polluters. I stand
for you and the safety of our kids, not guns. I stand for you and your
rights, not extremists trying to take them away. I stand for students and
teachers, not greed.

I stand for you and for those trying to afford a roof over their heads,
not tax cuts for big businesses. I stand for you and the most vulnerable,
not the richest amongst us. Simply put, I stand for you. And always will.

It’s worth asking what we’ve done:

We passed relief to help workers and working families get through a
once-in-a-generation pandemic. We passed the biggest infrastructure
investment in generations. We passed an Apollo-level investment in
fighting climate change. We passed major changes to lower the cost of
drugs. We passed a major expansion of healthcare for veterans.

Imagine two years ago if I had told you that we were going to accomplish
all that in two years. It’s hard to imagine. But here’s the thing, we’re
just getting started, and we must continue the progress. Not go backwards.

There’s so much work to do. And I can’t wait to get to it. From tackling
inflation to protecting your rights. From healthcare to housing. From
climate change to guns.

I hope I’ve earned your vote, and your trust. So please, go VOTE.

If you need to know how or where to vote, go to [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1410?t=1004&akid=1298%2E5257348%2EDFTfcX ]www.iwillvote.com. And
if you already have your ballot, simply drop it in the mailbox or ballot
drop box.

Thanks for doing your part for our democracy, and using your sacred right
to vote today. It truly matters.

Thanks,

Adam

| | | Hello Peter**Election Day is here; today is your last chance. body:
#
Good morning and happy Election Day, friends!
All of the work we’ve done since we launched this campaign back in July 2021 has been leading up to this.
But just because the polls are open doesn’t mean it’s too late to make a difference.
**We still need your support in order to keep our GOTV programs and advertising running through the end of the day.**
[**So please, rush one FINAL contribution to our campaign before the polls close tonight. We still need your help to win — and we must keep fighting until all the votes are cast in this election.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221108-1-tt&t=1&akid=4071%2E196590%2E1X9F_Q)
This is going to be an incredibly close race, and the truth is that it could come down to turnout.
And there’s still time to reach more Wisconsinites with our message and get them out to vote for Mandela. So we can’t take our foot off the gas yet.
**Please, use this link to make a contribution to Mandela to power our GOTV program through Election Day:**
[**https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/Election-Day**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=mandela-em-nov22.Jaf-Cy&refcode=em221108-1-tt&t=2&akid=4071%2E196590%2E1X9F_Q)
Thank you. We’re all incredibly grateful for your support.
Now let’s go win!
\- Team Mandela

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you. Dick

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: Reflections on Election Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221108&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221108&amount=28]
Friend,
Today is the day!
As I headed to my polling location in Lansing this morning, I reflected on all we have been through the past few years. No matter the outcome of tonight, representing Michigan’s 8th district has been the greatest honor of my life, and it has been a privilege to get to know so many wonderful people while running for the new 7th.
I’ve been able to do this because so many people like you have been so generous with their time and donations and support. I am so proud of the campaign you helped us build ( and I want you to be involved in our election night watch party live-stream, which you can access here [https://www.facebook.com/elissaslotkin] ).
It’s no secret that our country is going through something right now. As I look back at the past year, the prevailing theme of this campaign can be summed up in a conversation I had with Jon Meacham, historian and author of the book “Soul of America.” When we spoke over the summer, I asked him to give me some historical context that puts the tough times our country is going through into perspective, to tell me that we’ve been through this before, and that it’s not as bad as it seems.
In this country’s darkest times – the Civil War, the Great Depression, the McCarthy era, the civil rights movement, the Vietnam war – there were always two things that pulled us out of it. Engaged citizens and principled leaders.
I’m given hope by people like you and all of the people I’ve met in the new 7th who have gotten up off the sidelines. The folks who have ran for state office, local office, and school board. The people that passionately advocate for the issues that impact their communities. And, the folks in mid-Michigan’s many conservative areas who may not be the most outspoken, but who demonstrate an act of courage each day just by showing up and doing what they can.
None of us wanted to live through a moment of political instability like this, but it is our responsibility to meet this moment. I thank you for being an engaged citizen. My hope is that when I wake up in the morning, I get to be that principled leader Michigan’s new 7th district deserves.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221108&amount=28]
Elissa

body:
This is important | Do you have a minute? I know you've been bombarded with messages from my campaign and others recently...
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61825756:J_8Pp6GAN:m:1:3373497171:3146B5CEFA32C28AE0A8C7DB4609069E:r)

Peter,

**Do you have a minute?**

I know you've been bombarded with messages from my campaign and others recently, but I wanted to reach out personally with one final update on our fight to take back Arizona.

Due to the support of patriots like YOU, our America First movement has defied all odds, and we have surged into a position to win this race. Despite everything the Left has thrown at us, we have Mark Kelly and his failing campaign on the ropes and are on the verge of reclaiming our state and our Senate Majority.

Arizonans have responded to our winning America First message of restoring border security, a functioning economy, and law and order to our communities - **all of which Mark Kelly has failed to do as your Senator.**

Let's be clear: **Mark Kelly lied to you.** He promised to be a moderate and independent voice in the Senate, but has voted in lockstep with Biden's extreme agenda at every turn.

He's had ample opportunities to secure our border, stand up for American workers, and protect our children but has bowed to the far-Left fringes of the Democratic Party Every. Single. Time.

Arizonans have had enough of Kelly's lies and are ready for change. They're ready for a Senator who will vote in THEIR best interests rather than rubber-stamping an extreme, toxic, far-Left agenda.

You have my word; I will be that Senator. Now, we need to finish what we started out to do. I'm asking for your support one last time. Any contribution made today will go directly toward our final Get-Out-The-Vote efforts and give us the critical final push needed to get to the finish line and WIN this election.

Peter, I'm confident that with your support, we will win this election. **Will you stand with us as we TAKE BACK ARIZONA?**

**[Please chip in whatever you can TODAY to stand with our America First movement as we take back Arizona and the Senate.>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61825756:J_8Pp6GAN:m:1:3373497171:3146B5CEFA32C28AE0A8C7DB4609069E:r)**

Thank you,

Blake Masters
U.S. Senate Candidate from Arizona

**[CONTRIBUTE NOW>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61825756:J_8Pp6GAN:m:1:3373497171:3146B5CEFA32C28AE0A8C7DB4609069E:r)**

You're an important part of this team, and your involvement in this race is the reason that we are in a strong position to flip this Senate seat. I am incredibly grateful to know that we are in this together.

When polls close in Wisconsin this evening, I want to know that we did everything we possibly could to defeat Ron Johnson. In a race that will be as close as this one, we simply cannot afford to leave anything up to chance.

Now, I know that we've asked a lot of you during the final stretch before Election Day. And that is because we are funding this campaign the right way – no corporate PAC money, just lots of people contributing what they can to help send Ron Johnson packing.

So today, I need to ask you one more time:

[Can I count on you to please contribute $10 to my campaign today? disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA
body:
We have a lot to get done still.

Derek, there’s only a little bit of time left before the polls close. ****[That's why I have to ask you to support our campaign to win the Pennsylvania Governor’s race — will you contribute right now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54331201/378145738/360385765?refcode=email_110822_resend_eomlastchance_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=8bc09ebd-a85f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YmMwOWViZC1hODVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x4SvGRxYnOHVoyMVY7NqK4srSHLTomGUKoovS6o8g8I=)**** We have just a few hours left to talk with voters, build a winning coalition, and get everyone excited to vote today. And with time running out, that’s a lot to get done. **_But I know that this team will do anything it takes to win on tonight._** From knocking doors to talking to friends and family or from donating to posting on social media, there are so many ways people across the Commonwealth have gotten involved and supported this campaign today. And trust me, we need your support. That’s because running for Governor is never easy and it’s an uphill battle in Pennsylvania — one of the most competitive battlegrounds in the country. Races here are won by razor-thin margins. body:
I am so, so grateful.

**** Morning, Team! I’m emailing you from the car between GOTV events. Real quick, I wanted to say THANK YOU for everything you’ve done to support me in this race. We have a real shot at victory today, and that wouldn’t have been possible without an incredible team of grassroots supporters like you having my back every step of the way. I am so grateful for everything you’ve done, and no matter what happens tonight, I will never, ever forget it. This campaign has always been about fighting for the regular people whose needs so often go overlooked in Washington — fighting for economic future, for our basic civil rights, and for our ability to live in a functioning democracy. We are in a tough, tough fight, and we’ve faced horrendous false attacks from my right-wing opponent and GOP super PACs — but each time, thanks to this team, we’ve gotten back up and stayed in the race. With only hours to go, let’s keep working to deliver a victory — for Colorado, for our nation, and for the regular Americans who deserve a voice in Washington. With gratitude,
Brittany **p.s. If you’re willing, I could still use your support in these final hours to fund our GOTV efforts and keep our digital ads online to help persuade voters who are still making up their mind. Peter,

It's hard to believe that Election Day is finally here.

Today, Democrats, Republicans, and Independents -- people from all walks of life and every community in Oklahoma -- will vote for a future where we work together, not one where we keep ourselves divided over political labels.

Before the first votes are even tallied, it's clear that a powerful, positive movement has been mobilized in our state. Oklahoma belongs to you, and the people are ready to elect a governor who works for everyone.

We couldn't have done this without incredible grassroots support. Our volunteers knocked on 140,000 doors to talk to their neighbors. We sent 600,000 text messages to remind our fellow Oklahomans what's at stake in this election. And we had thousands of people pitch in their hard-earned dollars to help us build a coalition to win.

| Dear Kansans,

Today is the day to decide what kind of country you want to live in. This election has come at a critical moment in time. Inflation is skyrocketing, our Second Amendment rights are under attack, our southern border is a disaster zone, most families' values aren’t taught in their children’s schools, and the right to life is still in jeopardy. In the midst of all this, the American way of life is thriving in places like Kansas, where the values that still make this country great are alive and well: faith, family, love of neighbor, personal responsibility, and freedom.

Please get out and vote today like I just did. It’s an honor to serve you in Washington, D.C. Let’s take our country back today. Let’s make our voices heard all across this nation.

Sincerely,

Rep. Tracey Mann

Friend,

**Do you have a minute?**

I know you've been bombarded with messages from my campaign and others recently, but I wanted to reach out personally with one final update on our fight to take back Arizona.

Due to the support of patriots like YOU, our America First movement has defied all odds, and we have surged into a position to win this race. Despite everything the Left has thrown at us, we have Mark Kelly and his failing campaign on the ropes and are on the verge of reclaiming our state and our Senate Majority.

Arizonans have responded to our winning America First message of restoring border security, a functioning economy, and law and order to our communities - **all of which Mark Kelly has failed to do as your Senator.**

Let's be clear: **Mark Kelly lied to you.** He promised to be a moderate and independent voice in the Senate, but has voted in lockstep with Biden's extreme agenda at every turn.

He's had ample opportunities to secure our border, stand up for American workers, and protect our children but has bowed to the far-Left fringes of the Democratic Party Every. Single. Time.

Arizonans have had enough of Kelly's lies and are ready for change. They're ready for a Senator who will vote in THEIR best interests rather than rubber-stamping an extreme, toxic, far-Left agenda.

You have my word; I will be that Senator. Now, we need to finish what we started out to do. I'm asking for your support one last time. Any contribution made today will go directly toward our final Get-Out-The-Vote efforts and give us the critical final push needed to get to the finish line and WIN this election.

Friend, I'm confident that with your support, we will win this election. **Will you stand with us as we TAKE BACK ARIZONA?**

**[Please chip in whatever you can TODAY to stand with our America First movement as we take back Arizona and the Senate.>>](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zucju9pedbkviq3eia5r62cj8o24hm8qsidppgi8_rp22sh2s8i66or7cjgmcp31cth2bs)**

Thank you,

Blake Masters

Peter, today is the big day. Right now, the polls are open across Texas. **[That means Team Vallejo will be going all-out from now until polls close tonight at 7pm. But we need your support — will you chip in now to fund our day-of voter contact to ensure the people of TX-15 have the info they need to cast their ballot?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wj0IZ8dCDR2RipYyjhotr5rJSxs4-9-OiE10iuvSKQWT9g4_aSxL0PabqHLYzEV_oMUz79I86V22VzM4wv-CvjxfUAv0rik8LBcCq8dAiWWfcZyz-mCFZOhsyX2t8iBJm-gL2Q--GJn3yPODnpxGwXUYVpq6qJqtscqg17jq7TbjPB0fvDFlvHGk2JyxF1jGVUQ0BH5svgrMADez9J-mB4Pp8Slb0a3UKdhXfTUuKRgJieH4P1bhGaH1n6YIxssLlVpgo74baf_svK1wgOZfPNcEYfVWiDIn0MLRcAdSJikNKsAuZY35Yvaa8CcdpiG9RjB5OEmMS1rGPDhey_U1GFbWpQedfuuqQ-4mpSVGQHBe1efmUqnsfWezcZc5F9Y3M3Rrz0twuGkzt3LNC97Orp/3qz/ceqQrXxNRpO-JxLOQuvvTg/h1/gnN3BRV9j3uJX2tr6gHdlccps9Ha2gfmzwCbsn1uJGc)** We’re gearing up for the longest 8 hours of this election. # Today is Election Day!
I would be honored to have your vote and serve you in US Congress.
[](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=45b2f7ba68&e=e60663a86e)
**A Word of Thanks as We Cross the Finish Line****Thank you again to everyone who has supported my campaign.** To all the folks who have generously donated, who volunteered, who followed + liked + reposted me on social media, who have attended events, mailed postcards, put out yard signs, and so much more, thank you for all you have done. I’m truly appreciative of all your ongoing support and your vote! It’s been one hell of a ride, and win or lose tonight, I wanted you to know just how thankful I am for your support during this race.Let’s keep up the momentum today and finish this race to the end.With Sincere Gratitude,
Mike[**mike4georgia.com**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=33043ed55d&e=e60663a86e)
|

1\. Go to: [**mvp.sos.ga.gov**](https://mike4georgia.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=16fa4d921be51d1ef17419452&id=1eee9151b1&e=e60663a86e) to find your polling location
2\. Voting hours: 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM If you're in line by 7:00 PM, you can vote
3\. Georgia’s Coalition for the People is offering free rides to the polls for people who need them. Please call: 877-524-8683

subject: Have you seen what they're doing to our kids?
body:
| | | Dear Peter, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That 's why I'm asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61825700:JjVSL6GjN:m:1:3253819041:220F1BFC721AA9524A35F8A1F61811E3:r) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they're doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we're going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that's exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** 's great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter's school and told that her daughter was now a "boy". She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was "transgender" and "bisexual"... Her impressionable daughter didn't even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica's innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy's name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a "Gender Support Plan" and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother's knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn 't be "trusted"****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They're not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They're not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They're not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent's values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That 's why I'm asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61825700:JjVSL6GjN:m:1:3253819041:220F1BFC721AA9524A35F8A1F61811E3:r) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and "interviewed" her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it's happening in secret so parents, grandparents and the community don't know what's going on. Jessica's innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don't act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It's horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That's why our lawsuit names the individual "teachers" \-- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61825700:JjVSL6GjN:m:1:3253819041:220F1BFC721AA9524A35F8A1F61811E3:r) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today - $50, $100, $250 or more - I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don't just file lawsuits - we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we're fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we're going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61825700:JjVSL6GjN:m:1:3253819041:220F1BFC721AA9524A35F8A1F61811E3:r) We're ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can't do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,
---

Harmeet K. Dhillon

body:
Two important things for you.
#
This is the last email asking for $$$ that you’ll get from me, Derek. So I want to start with the most important stuff first:
THANK YOU. Thank you, thank you, thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for everything you have done to get us to this point. It really means the world to me, Gisele + our whole campaign family. ❤️❤️❤️
It hasn’t always been easy — _like when Oz + the GOP spent $100 million on attack ads about me_ — but you’ve been by our side through all of it. I truly feel like the luckiest dude.
Who's chopping onions over here? 😭😭
Okay, back to why I’m emailing you in the middle of Election Day: **[I’m asking you to rush your very first donation of our campaign today. Your support right now will help us turn out voters in the final hours of this election.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221108-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221108-8117&refcode2=8117_434096_YDpM-u&akid=8117%2E434096%2EYDpM-u)**
**[RUSH $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221108-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221108-8117&refcode2=8117_434096_YDpM-u&akid=8117%2E434096%2EYDpM-u)**
Whatever you can afford to give today will not go to waste. We’re taking those donations and putting them right back into online ads, texts, phone calls + door knocks to make sure Pennsylvanians get out and VOTE.
I know we’ve asked a lot out of you since this campaign launched way back in February 2021. And I know these emails have only increased in the past few months. **But it all comes down to today, Derek.**
With the latest polls showing me + Oz statistically tied, and MAGA PACs emptying out their war chest to attack us in the final days of this race, it’s going to take an unprecedented amount of people power to pull ahead.
**Which is why I’m asking you, for one last time today:[Can you please rush your very first $5 donation today? Even just $5 can help us reach another voter to make sure they turn out before polls close.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221108-1?amount=5&refcode=em20221108-8117&refcode2=8117_434096_YDpM-u&akid=8117%2E434096%2EYDpM-u)**
And one last time before polls close, Derek: Thank you.
❤️ John

Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

Peter,

We got into this work for two reasons:

First, we saw the scale of crises we were facing and knew the political
establishment would not rise to meet them without an intervention.

Second, we knew we could build our own power from the ground up, and lead
with a better vision for our politics, our people, and our country.

We know you’re here because you share that vision. Like us, you believe in
the hard work of transforming our democracy & the Democratic Party from
the inside out. We work year-round, cycle after cycle, to recruit, train,
endorse, support, and elect new generations of progressives who will fight
for working people.

Today, we get to go out and vote for leaders in our own communities who
will fight for us — and in Tennessee, Pennsylvania, and Texas, voters have
the chance to elect our Justice Democrats. A lot is on the line. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/120406?t=1001&akid=25962%2E1203867%2Eh0ySGN ]So if
you have the right to vote, we urge you to exercise it and vote today,
because your choice does matter.

We are in this work for the long run, which means we will be ready
tomorrow to wake up and keep fighting, no matter what — and we hope you’ll
be with us when you do. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/120406?t=1002&akid=25962%2E1203867%2Eh0ySGN ]But today, please do all you can for your
community — and go vote!

Thank you for being a part of this movement with us.

Greg

body:
Representing this district has been the greatest honor of my life.

| Peter,

As we reach the end of Election Day, I am overcome with gratitude for this team.

Growing up in a military family, I never lived in one place for very long. When I moved to the Lehigh Valley more than 30 years ago, I fell in love with the community, and I knew this was where I wanted to stay and raise a family.

Representing this district has been the greatest honor of my life, and I look forward to continuing to advocate for our families and workers regardless of tonight’s outcome. I am so thankful for the tireless work of our grassroots campaign.

_**Good morning Nevada,**

**Today, Nevadans have the opportunity to vote for a better direction: lower costs, economic prosperity, a secure border, and less crime. We can stop the radical Biden-Cortez Masto agenda by replacing Biden’s rubber stamp in Senate with a real voice for Nevadans. **

**If you want a Senator who supports law enforcement and American energy independence, and who will stop inflationary spending and higher taxes, you have to go vote today.**

**Jaime and I just voted in our hometown of Reno and if you haven’t voted yet, we encourage you to get out and vote. The polls close at 7pm PT tonight. **

**Your voice matters. Nevada matters.**

**God bless,**
**Adam**_

Good morning, Peter. It’s Yadira, and the first thing I wanted to do today was say _thank you_. From canvassing, to voting, to donating, it has been incredibly humbling and inspiring to see all the work this team has done to help my campaign. I am deeply honored to have your support. No matter what happens today, being your Democratic nominee for CO-08 has been the honor of a lifetime.

**Thank you for being part of Team Caraveo.**

I meant it when I said this race was personal for me. I’m running for Congress because my community deserves better, and I want to bring positive change to the place I am lucky to call my home. I have experienced firsthand what happens when politicians make bad decisions, and I decided to run for Congress because it’s time for us to work together to get things done for Colorado families.

_**If we win, there is so much we will be able to accomplish**_ – in Congress, I will fight to lower health care costs, address the high cost of living, and protect a woman’s right to choose. _And, if we win, it will mean that Colorado will be sending its first Latina to Congress._

body:
Rush support for same-day voter registration!
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2b975d10-4535-430c-9cb1-d8def060ab9a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | Peter, It was a long road but here we are, Election Day. I voted (woo-hoo!), and otherwise as I sit here in my office wondering what this is going to look like when the smoke clears, I figured I'd tell ya one more time--**_REMEMBER TO VOTE! And Vote Blue All The Way Through, As Our Democracy Is On The Line Here!!_** Also: * Maybe you thought you'd registered but aren't. Maybe in this crazy thing we all call life, you just plain forgot. **_Well, that won't stop you in nearly half our states, because they have same day voter registration up through closing time today! _** **_Here's a list from West to East: Hawaii, Washington, California, Idaho, Nevada, Wyoming, Colorado, Utah, New Mexico, Minnesota, Iowa, Wisconsin, Illinois, Michigan, Virginia, Washington, D.C., Maryland, Connecticut, Vermont, New Hampshire, Maine. If you live in any of these, and you aren't registered, please go register right now!_** **_We need to reelect Senator Catherine Cortez Masto and Governor Sisolak in Nevada, take out Lauren Boebert with Adam Frisch in Colorado, hold onto Governors seats in Minnesota (Waltz), Wisconsin (Evers, which is very close!), have a chance_** to knock off seditionist traitors Mike Lee in Utah, Charles Grassley in Iowa and Ron Johnson in Wisconsin, and much more!! [Rock The Vote has you covered on this, please click on this link and you can find out poll-closing times and make sure your voice is heard and you protect our democracy!!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7f4d058b-d6c6-4e32-97c1-d6ef05a998c2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) * **_Our friends at Voters of Tomorrow, who are registering Gen Z voters like it's their job (which...I guess it is). Gen Z, voters of color and women are going to be what saves us this election, as they did with the Kansas Abortion Referendum, in Alaska by rejecting Palin and in NY-19 by overcoming an 8% deficit for a 2% win! [Voters of Tomorrow is still registering voters in states where they can. Go support them with a small donation so they can keep going ‘til registration shuts down!!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td9bd948b-5562-44b4-a351-e52e7a7b7b23/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** * **_Finally, if you need to get pumped up, I have that for you! I voted earlier today. I was even harassed by a Republican when I rejected their garbage literature a block from my polling place.[ You can go here and watch the video and get pumped to vote!!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5d3205d8-028c-41fe-aafd-7207109b746b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _** **_[And you can go here to subscribe to the channel!!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T60953c32-bb4d-4a03-a241-4a52ecc71fa4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** **Otherwise, let's all do our favorite superstitious behaviors, hope like hell, and know we did all we could to win this thing. Ok, my friends, go get 'em! ** Cliff

name: Joe Shepherd, President of United Rural Democrats
subject: This isn't my first rodeo, Peter.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by United Rural Democrats](https://click
body:
I want to thank you. | | | Hi Peter – This isn't my first election night rodeo. I've spent time on many campaigns, and Election Day never stops being scary. This election feels different though. **The issues at stake on the ballot have never been higher.** Our votes are being cast for reproductive rights, voting rights, protection of democracy, action on climate change, quality education, treatment of workers, and so many more critical issues. Like many of you, I'm planted on my couch at home to watch the results come in. I wanted to take a moment to make sure that I say thank you, Peter. **Your willingness to go above and beyond for Democrats has not gone unnoticed. Rural Democrats, such as myself, have often been left behind – both by Democrats and Republicans.** This election season, I'm proud that our organization was part of breaking that cycle and mending the relationships between the Democratic Party and many rural voters. **We still have more work to do** , but the volunteers, supporters, Democratic candidates, and community leaders who have shown up for rural districts in the past year have been an incredible achievement. **Peter, thank you for being a part of this team, and for supporting rural Democrats.** – Joe Shepherd, President of United Rural Democrats
