subject: Team, this is the last time I’ll ask
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Charlie Crist
body:
Team, I know I’ve reached out a lot over the past several months, but this is the last time I’ll ask you to pitch in to give Florida a fighting chance at a better future. I hope I can count on you for a last-minute donation.

Donate to the Future of Florida Fund > https://secure.actblue.com/donate/focc-em-nov2022?amount=25&refcode=20221108_f_8

From the bottom of my heart, I am truly thankful to have supporters like you on my team. In the face of Ron DeSantis’s hateful agenda, we’ve built a grassroots movement committed to restoring decency and fighting for what’s right.

Because even though Ron DeSantis might not care about decency, I’m fully convinced that a majority of Floridians still do. Together, we can stand up to bullies like Ron DeSantis and create the future we dream of for Florida — a future where we treat others as we’d like to be treated and build a Florida for All.

This is our final shot to bring an end to authoritarianism in Florida, team, so I hope you’re still with me. Will you rush an urgent donation to my team’s Future of Florida Fund before tonight’s deadline at 7pm?

> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/focc-em-nov2022?amount=25&refcode=20221108_f_8

Thank you, and God bless.

— Charlie

VOTE TODAY! Don't be Late!

PRESS RELEASE - NOV 8, ELECTION DAY

PRESS RELEASE - ELECTION 'DAY' IN WA - WHAT TO EXPECT

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Nov. 8, 2022, Kennewick, WA. Brad Klippert, the Republican write-in candidate for Washington's Secretary of State, believes that
every single citizen in WA State deserves to have the right to know that when they cast their ballot it will not be manipulated in
any way, shape, or form.

WA State Ballot Return Statistics [https://email.mg.msgsndr.org/c/eJxNjz9vgzAUxD9NvMXimWDD4KF_1KlKI1VqaZbo8TBgxWBku5B8-5Kt0g2nuxvuRxfb6nWBj3N9L4raG3W_voaX2ydznh7d95c9nurl-nxqBrA_9fn9WDEzonWXdJ-NJhxntP3ErBaZEABZCSUUAFwqBVJ1nSQUlFG2O2Rjz8fYx6kN3IeeDboQVVUeiERXGCXUtkbKmkoRAhRNJZnTQ0pz3OVPO_G2aV1XHn3kK_LeL1tgnKFk_RQ3H0w0GGjYbIPO-bQPJv2GaR8TJhuTpcgxzjcWdDuv1jkbpdpu9Q8cTn78B_Zgl7nECkqDJUpQDRYSDZQdMqNBSlXlkINgrS6py1Fmf33ya3U] as of Tuesday morning
show that less than 40% of the registered voters have returned their ballots. Washington state voters have waited to vote on
election day!

Rep. Klippert urges every registered voter to cast their ballot by 8 pm tonight, November 8th. Don’t forget and don’t be late!

Those voting today should deliver their ballot in person to their local drop box or their local auditor's office. Voters can and
should track the progress of their ballot at https://email.mg.msgsndr.org/c/eJxNjzFvgzAUhH9NPFp-uH42g4emVacqjdQqoVmih23ACsQIEAn_vrBVOt1wN9x37hq9fczwdSkWpYoU9HJ7H96e36xNbuvOp3g4FvNtfywbiL_F5fOQs9BRbK_T0gfrqOsp1ncWbSayDEAYMKAAOGoNqKsKHWVOOLF7EV3Nu7Ee737gaahZY4V0xqtQau-NzHOhsFSCUFbSCOGFZK1tpqkfd_J1l32smtMUBr75g3id5jU6N2EIP-m0ZpzG_skG6_tHbNs4ol5H6w2Wu9T9w96eoUTKwQQyhKBLUkgBTEUsWEDUuQQJGfPWuEoSij8fUV5T [https://email.mg.msgsndr.org/c/eJxNjzFvgzAUhH9NPFp-uH42g4emVacqjdQqoVmih23ACsQIEAn_vrBVOt1wN9x37hq9fczwdSkWpYoU9HJ7H96e36xNbuvOp3g4FvNtfywbiL_F5fOQs9BRbK_T0gfrqOsp1ncWbSayDEAYMKAAOGoNqKsKHWVOOLF7EV3Nu7Ee737gaahZY4V0xqtQau-NzHOhsFSCUFbSCOGFZK1tpqkfd_J1l32smtMUBr75g3id5jU6N2EIP-m0ZpzG_skG6_tHbNs4ol5H6w2Wu9T9w96eoUTKwQQyhKBLUkgBTEUsWEDUuQQJGfPWuEoSij8fUV5T]
to make sure that their ballot was accepted and processed.

Anyone who would like to share a photo of delivering their ballot to a dropbox is welcome to post one on the Write In Klippert
Campaign Public Facebook Group [https://email.mg.msgsndr.org/c/eJxNj81ugzAQhJ8GH5EXBxsffOiPeqrSSJVamku0rG1iATEyNJS3L_RUaU7zzUgzdAnWLHd4O9drWdbRqbV7Tk8_76yPtLPPj3A81ffu8dRcIXzV59ejZm7A0F_mdXSGcBgxtDcWTMGLAoBXUEEJkEulQCrvJWFBnHh24EObD1M73WzKY2rZ1VgtuZeiJN_oraS9IGUVNd4TKn1QrDfXeR6nTDxkxcumZVlyj-SaGLuc4rBZbYrfW2JjKcwu3JqEtuvDOLo0_zGWjB2X0Pdhkmpb0e7r9_K_H_tVKSRqqBxWKEE1WEp0UHlkzoCUSgsQUDBrKvICJf8FvB1mJA].

Those who vote today should NOT place their ballot in the U.S. Mail, as staff shortages continue to plague many local post office
locations. There is no guarantee ballots will be postmarked on time, especially late in the day.

Due to Washington’s mail-in ballot process, the final results of the election will not be known until the election is certified on
November 29.

Votes for write-in candidates are not counted until there is a significant number of write-in votes. Then each county election
team will go back and adjudicate the race to determine how many votes were earned by Rep. Klippert. Every county is slightly
different, so contact your local GOP Committee for more information from the local election observers.

Rep. Klippert has been endorsed by the Washington State Republican Party [https://email.mg.msgsndr.org/c/eJxNj7tuhDAQRb9mXSKPvYxN4SIPpYo2K0VKyDarsbHB4mUBWsLfB7pItzvFPcfdY2XWB3zcyi3Py9GrrX2dXn4_WTe6g31_xcu1fLTPV9tA_Clv75eC-Z5id1-25I2jPlGsBxaN4EIAcA0acoAMlQJUIaAj4bjjpzPv66yf63mopmycatYYaZW2HjGXVisJVUDprQceKLdnB4p1plmWNJ_k00m87VvXNVunuPg4tF1MyU9L5sZ-J2wyVVpj18UZ1f5VH44H-2d7BKFEKkB70oSgLOVIHnQg5g0gqkKCBMEqo12QhPwPBNdbnw], and 31 out of 39 of
the county GOP Committees. He’s also been endorsed by The Conservative Ladies of Washington State, and the organization We Believe
We Vote. The Write In Klippert Campaign has captured the excitement and enthusiasm of grassroots Republicans from all across the
state.

body:
| **Peter, this will only take a minute:**

Right now, millions of Americans are making their voices heard at the polls.

**This is it, Peter. Today is Election Day!**

As a kid, I never could have imagined this moment. Growing up in the 1960s South, no one gave me a chance to do much of anything — but I made my way. I became the first in my family to graduate college, then Orlando's first woman chief of police, and finally I flipped my Congressional district blue.

I can't thank you enough for dreaming of a better America with me – one where a poor Black girl from Jacksonville can grow up to run in one of the most competitive Senate races in the country. Because of you, I'm tied with Marco Rubio, and I just need to ask for your help one last time.

While my opponent and I have different values and priorities, she loves this country as I do. The volunteers, the people who have donated, the prayer warriors, and our family, have sustained us through this race and on this, Election Day, we wanted to say thank you.We wouldn’t be here without you and we are so grateful for all you’ve done to guide us.

body:
Vote by 8PM Tonight!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

body:
Eric Lynn for Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP24/1/93680/images/lynn-email-logo.png]
Hi team,

The polls are officially closed, and my team and I are waiting for the results to come in. As we huddle around the news, I want to take this time to thank you for supporting my campaign journey.

These past few months have been hard work and have not been easy. As you know, Republicans have done everything they can to make this district skew Republican, pouring in millions of dollars to flip FL-13 red.

What I'm most appreciative of is how we rose above their illegal gerrymandering and scare tactics. We fought hard and ran a campaign that we can all be proud of tonight.

You were a key part of that success, team. Whether you followed us on social media to spread the word, volunteered with our team, cast your vote for Democrats today, told friends or neighbors about this race, or donated resources to help fuel our campaign, you played a critical role.

As we wait for the results to trickle in, I just wanted to leave you with this. Though this Election Day was a crucial milestone, the fight does not stop here.

Protecting our rights, democracy, and principles will not be easily won. Republicans have proved that it will be a constant battle.

I'm ready to keep up that fight, and I hope that you'll continue it with me.

Thank you, team, for all of your support.

— Eric Lynn
Eric Lynn is a former Senior Advisor to President Obama, national security expert, small business owner, community advocate, and St. Petersburg Native who is ready to lead Pinellas County forward. Empathic, passionate, and pragmatic, Eric knows how to get the job done in Washington on day one.

body:
#
Friends -
I'm reaching out today to say thank you.
You're an important part of this team, and your involvement in this race is the reason that we are in a strong position to flip this Senate seat. I am incredibly grateful to know that we are in this together.
When polls close in Wisconsin this evening, I want to know that we did everything we possibly could to defeat Ron Johnson. In a race that will be as close as this one, we simply cannot afford to leave anything up to chance.
Now, I know that we've asked a lot of you during the final stretch before Election Day. And that is because we are funding this campaign the right way – no corporate PAC money, just lots of people contributing what they can to help send Ron Johnson packing.
So today, I need to ask you one more time:

body:
| Team —

It’s hard to believe, but polls are now closed in Michigan. Remember: if you were in line by 8 p.m. ET, stay in line—you are still able to vote.

As we wait for results, we wanted to share with you what to expect tonight:

**We have always known this race will be close.** Michigan’s Eighth Congressional District is one of the most competitive districts in the entire country. Dan’s district is the median House district in the entire country—meaning there are 217 more Democratic seats, and 217 more Republican seats. Over $17 million has been spent on this congressional race, because it could control the balance of Congress.

**It will take time to count all the votes.** Over 100,000 people voted early by absentee ballot in our district. It takes time to pre-process and count these ballots, which local clerks by law are not allowed to tabulate until Election Day.

**If you don’t see immediate results, that’s OK!** In 2020, our race was called the day after Election Day. Michigan’s Secretary of State has said that it could take up to 24 hours for every vote to be counted, so we may not know the results tonight.

Here at Team Kildee, we will be working around-the-clock to keep you updated as votes are counted. Your continued support—your contributions, volunteer efforts and encouragement—mean the world to Dan and our team.

From the bottom of our hearts, THANK YOU to each and every one of you!

— All of us at Kildee HQ

| | | Hi there,

**The day we've been working towards is finally here — it's Election Day and polls are open until 8:00p.m. **

It's not too late to #FireFitz and elect real leadership to represent us in Washington D.C. [**Head to mikevansomeren.com/vote**](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=f593181b89&e=356c0699dd)** to make your plan to vote Mike Van Someren for Congress today.**

Let's make the American Dream a reality for every American family.

Happy voting,
Calvin
Team Van Someren
---
| [PLAN TO VOTE](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=c3d2602071&e=356c0699dd "PLAN TO VOTE")
---
|
---
| November 7, 2022

Hi there,

**Well, folks, tomorrow is the day — Election Day**. I set out over a year ago to challenge Scott Fitzgerald, fight for American families, and bring common-sense leadership to Washington D.C.

Throughout the campaign I’ve had the privilege of meeting and listening to folks all over the district about what they expect of their Congressman, their hopes for the future of our state and country, and their frustrations with current leadership. I wanted to run this campaign like I believe a member of congress should run their office, by actually going to the people, listening to their thoughts and concerns, and then responding.

**Scott Fitzgerald has shown us time and again that the LAST thing he cares about is American families or what their hopes or concerns may be. He will choose his party and the special interests lining his pockets _every single time._**

When it comes to addressing the real, kitchen table issues affecting all of us here at home, Scott Fitzgerald is nowhere to be found.**We cannot continue to tolerate this behavior — we can replace him by[voting Mike Van Someren for Congress at the polls tomorrow.](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=6063b51907&e=356c0699dd) **
---
| [ ](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=dd4fc39a97&e=356c0699dd)
---
| [PLAN TO VOTE](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=1afaabdc05&e=356c0699dd "PLAN TO VOTE")
---
| Scott Fitzgerald and his party thrive on our division, but we are more alike than we are different. We all want better for our families, and I believe that starts with:
* Restoring our Democracy
* Restoring public safety
* Rebuilding the middle class
* Protecting Roe and our right to privacy
* Prioritizing environmental stewardship

**I’m running for Congress to fight for the foundation of our country.** I’m running because we deserve a representative who will put in the work of listening and helping solve problems faced by our country — not contribute even more to the extreme polarization that’s already paralyzed our government.

**Scott Fitzgerald has been the opposite of all of those things. The 5th Congressional District — and Wisconsin as a whole — deserves better.**

[If I can earn your vote at the polls tomorrow, November 8](https://MikeVanSomeren.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a8d3e4f455e56b0d81700f39a&id=d614643e64&e=356c0699dd), we will be one step closer to fixing the broken system in Washington for good.

I’m so proud to be on this journey with you. Thank you.

Mike Van Someren

I want to thank you, friend.

When we launched the NDRC in 2017, I couldn’t have imagined the path we’d take. Together, we helped win elections, advance reforms, secure fair maps, and push back against right-wing attempts to gerrymander – leading to the fairest congressional map in 40 years.

And along the way, in response to an overarching, anti-democratic strategy from too many in the GOP, we’ve had to expand our focus to protect voting rights and democracy.

This community has been there every step of the way, and I can’t thank you enough for that. In a few hours, we’ll get the first election results. **But no matter how things play out tonight and in the next few days, I know our struggle isn’t over.**

Dear friends, Today’s the day. All the hard work we’ve put into this campaign has led to this make-or-break moment. I’ll be honest, this campaign has been the most rewarding, exhausting, and exhilarating experience of my life. And I am feeling incredibly grateful for your support. **I am SO proud of the people-powered movement we’ve built here in southeastern PA.** When I launched my campaign, I never imagined seeing our constitutional rights ripped away from us and becoming a second-class citizen in the country I was willing to die to defend. I witnessed politicians like Brian Fitzpatrick, who has no skin in the game, let my community down. I saw children in similar situations that I had to endure as a child — the constant distress of not knowing where your next meal would come from or where you would live. No child should grow up that way. **I want this district to know I see you, I understand your struggle, and I’m going to fight like hell to change it.** Your vote is your voice, and today we have the power to turn the page and build a brighter future that belongs to ALL of us. Thank you for being part of this journey with me every step of the way. I really couldn’t have made it this far without you. Let’s get out there and fight with everything we’ve got to flip PA-01 blue! With gratitude, Ashley Ehasz | | Ashley Ehasz is a U.S. Army veteran, Apache helicopter pilot, and Democrat running to unseat Republican Brian Fitzpatrick and represent Pennsylvania’s 1st Congressional District: to provide our communities with the services and opportunities they need to thrive, to create positive change, and to ensure the next generation will have a better future ahead of them.

clean_body: | = Dear friends, Today’s the day. All the hard work we’ve put into this campaign has led to this make-or-break moment. I’ll be honest, this campaign has been the most rewarding, exhausting, and exhilarating experience of my life. And I am feeling incredibly grateful for your support. I am SO proud of the people-powered movement we’ve built here in southeastern PA. When I launched my campaign, I never imagined seeing our constitutional rights ripped away from us and becoming a second-class citizen in the country I was willing to die to defend. I witnessed politicians like Brian Fitzpatrick, who has no skin in the game, let my community down. I saw children in similar situations that I had to endure as a child — the constant distress of not knowing where your next meal would come from or where you would live. No child should grow up that way. I want this district to know I see you, I understand your struggle, and I’m going to fight like hell to change it. Your vote is your voice, and today we have the power to turn the page and build a brighter future that belongs to ALL of us. Thank you for being part of this journey with me every step of the way. I really couldn’t have made it this far without you. Let’s get out there and fight with everything we’ve got to flip PA-01 blue! Thank you doesn't even begin to describe just how thankful I am for all of your support. I’ve said it before, and tonight, I’ll say it again: _When Lisa goes to Washington,_** we all go to Washington.**

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: What Election Day means
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
We deserve it all.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221108-3598-header&t=1&akid=3598%2E2526796%2EpfBBxQ)
It’s not too much to ask to stay in the place you’ve always called home.
It’s not too much to ask to be able to see a doctor and not have it bankrupt you.
It’s not too much to have your civil rights protected, or your right to vote protected.
If we let people say that what we’re fighting for is ‘ _too pie in the sky_ ’, or ‘ _just youthful naivete_ ’, what we’re really doing is letting them talk down our own quality of life.
I know I might be young, but fighting for a better world is not some ‘naive’, ‘frolicking-in-the-meadow’ thing. Sometimes, those who oppose us try to frame our fight as ‘ _too much_ ’ – because of age, because of where we’re from. But really, **it’s because we’re fighting for what’s ours.** We’re fighting for what’s afforded to so many other communities.
Because at the end of the day, it’s not too much to ask. Communities like ours deserve it all.
Too often, we're made to feel by the powers that be — powers that don't want to see the working class win in this country — that our actions don't matter.
They do. They do make all the difference. We are not going to change the world by dropping out of it. Anything good that’s happened has always been against all odds. It’s always been David versus Goliath – but David always wins. And no matter what, we're in this fight together.
See you at the polls!
Alexandria

name: Delegate Jazz Lewis
subject: We did it!
body:
Team, We did it. We ran a strong campaign, and brought the community together to win . Thank you—your support means the world to me, and I’m honored to continue to serve as your voice in Annapolis.

None of this would have been possible without you, and it’s because of people like you that we are able to deliver results to our district and all Marylanders. We still are striving to make sure our community is more inclusive, and to make sure that we aren’t leaving anyone behind, no matter their zip code.

I’m incredibly grateful for your support, guidance, and friendship. I look forward to continuing to represent you as Delegate, and I am confident
we will stir up even more good trouble.

Thank you again and Godspeed,

Jazz

As a proven progressive leader and champion of issues ranging from criminal justice reform to healthcare access and economic equity, Jazz has represented the 24th Legislative District in Maryland’s House of Delegates since 2017. He also serves as Chair of the Maryland House Democratic Caucus. A lifelong Prince Georgian, Jazz lives in Glenarden with his wife and son.

body:
Peter, I wanted you to hear it from me first.

With the final votes being confirmed, I have officially been reelected to Congress. I'm so honored to continue serving as OH-11's Representative in Congress and grateful to each and every one of our grassroots supporters who stood alongside me on this journey.

It’s one of the greatest honors of my life to serve the people of OH-11, and I am eternally grateful that you have decided to send me back to Washington to fight for you and your family. Tomorrow, the hard work continues.

I promise to use my position to fight every day to ensure working-class Ohioans are heard in Congress. Together, we must strive to protect our abortion rights, expand access to our voting rights, tackle gun violence prevention efforts, and create an economy that truly works for us all.

Thank you for everything you’ve done this election cycle, Peter. It’s time to continue fighting back against the GOP and its extremist agenda. We’ve got a lot of work to do, so let’s get started.

In this fight together,

Shontel Brown
------------------
As a Cuyahoga County Council member and Chairwoman of the Cuyahoga County Democratic Party, Shontel Brown has spent the last decade serving the people of Ohio and building coalitions. Now, as the Congresswoman for Ohio’s 11th District, she will fight for affordable quality health care, jobs that pay fair wages, a strong public education system, and equity and justice for all. Will you join her and be the change we need?

body:
| | | [](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=f4087e0a6b544e50b3753adc43d161ac&_e=Gxd1ASIIoG2qLn9hfRsYu57lsURjnqKqi9V68HRS_3fpDDg37B_tMss75HhhXFMoUm8Yf_eVLjh1YsEZlH1UDoxkmYB6X8Yvhio5qCrlgr6_okpeeS4yQqQO7ZBvUv90SamLDR4K3DUj-5GVVJpmFNOsGFbvOfRXYqQsSl0Hp_Z7I6lnx2hCvC1ft5YI_bJ7iGkrfyMUOYGGVNdfhZs1ZCInl7MQIloaYGd2VF3URS4YHQvGwWctR8HymfFwZKSIiwTvW60HLeDuuvjbnTqQ11CDPPH9aiRUnDVkDCigKQdtg188-fS3qhbq4xtRIeru)
---
Friend,
---
Georgia. ** ** New Hampshire. ** ** Wisconsin. ** ** Pennsylvania. ** ** That’s where I’ve been over the past 48 hours.**
**
---
| |
---
| Today’s elections could change the course of history. So I haven’t wasted any time helping Republicans win. With polls open across the country, I’m sending one last message to remind you how much you’ve helped us accomplish and why voting today is so important.
---
| | We’ve traveled to Texas, Iowa, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, South Carolina, Illinois, Indiana, Tennessee, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Georgia, New Hampshire, and more. We endorsed, advised, and financially supported more than 60 conservative candidates. In the past 48 hours, we finished strong by building every bit of momentum we could.
---
| | I rallied with Herschel Walker in Georgia, a battleground race that could decide the fate of the Senate, and stumped with Gen. Bolduc in New Hampshire, where we’re on the verge of flipping New Hampshire red. I fought alongside Wisconsin Sen. Ron Johnson who is ready to defend his seat and continue standing up to the Left’s radical agenda, and took the stage for my last event of the cycle with Dr. Oz in Pennsylvania, where he’s doing everything he can to keep that seat in Republican hands. I’ve left no stone unturned.
---
|
---
---
| | After traveling across the country, I’ve had the chance to talk with many Americans about the state of our country. I’ve heard from parents who are fed up with schools failing our children; workers who are sick of inflation stealing our hard-earned money; and families who’ve had enough of the crime that’s destroying our cities.
---
| |
---
| Americans are struggling with the inevitable consequences of the Left’s agenda, and they’re desperate for the conservative solutions Republicans have to offer.
---
| | That’s why the men and women I’ve talked with are voting for Republicans in today’s election. They’re ready for change, and more importantly, they’re ready for conservative solutions.
---
| | [**But we can’t get complacent. We can’t assume victory just because America hungers for change. Republicans won’t win unless you show up to the polls and VOTE.**](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=f4087e0a6b544e50b3753adc43d161ac&_e=Gxd1ASIIoG2qLn9hfRsYu57lsURjnqKqi9V68HRS_3fpDDg37B_tMss75HhhXFMoUm8Yf_eVLjh1YsEZlH1UDoxkmYB6X8Yvhio5qCrlgr6_okpeeS4yQqQO7ZBvUv90SamLDR4K3DUj-5GVVJpmFNOsGFbvOfRXYqQsSl0Hp_bbgETL1Mit3cMM5VXhqLLYd3KJkjcjm84oqixTqbV_p5XFXbes93oKyTTISjDaJV7rcR2AqH_DKmdY7813jFhPovAMpm7qtUXvkbPiPbBPvSWhaPHbFrIXahaoCfEEtY2H-XnddG74nJGSGCdZvFCE)
---
|
---
| | Once the results start coming in tonight, it’s important to remember that our victories will mean nothing if Republicans fail to prove we deserve to be there. ** ** Every Republican who wins today must show up and start working on day one. We can’t continue to blame Democrats for all of America’s failures. We have to step up and do something about it. I endorsed more than 60 conservatives who I’m confident will do just that. Many of the endorsed candidates are fighting it out in neck and neck races. We’ve done everything in our power to get them this far, and now the final result rests with the American people.
---
| |
---

clean_body: | | | Friend, Georgia. New Hampshire. Wisconsin. Pennsylvania. That’s where I’ve been over the past 48 hours. | | | Today’s elections could change the course of history. So I haven’t wasted any time helping Republicans win. With polls open across the country, I’m sending one last message to remind you how much you’ve helped us accomplish and why voting today is so important. | | We’ve traveled to Texas, Iowa, New Jersey, New York, Virginia, South Carolina, Illinois, Indiana, Tennessee, Nevada, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Georgia, New Hampshire, and more. We endorsed, advised, and financially supported more than 60 conservative candidates. In the past 48 hours, we finished strong by building every bit of momentum we could. | | I rallied with Herschel Walker in Georgia, a battleground race that could decide the fate of the Senate, and stumped with Gen. Bolduc in New Hampshire, where we’re on the verge of flipping New Hampshire red. I fought alongside Wisconsin Sen. Ron Johnson who is ready to defend his seat and continue standing up to the Left’s radical agenda, and took the stage for my last event of the cycle with Dr. Oz in Pennsylvania, where he’s doing everything he can to keep that seat in Republican hands. I’ve left no stone unturned. | | | After traveling across the country, I’ve had the chance to talk with many Americans about the state of our country. I’ve heard from parents who are fed up with schools failing our children; workers who are sick of inflation stealing our hard-earned money; and families who’ve had enough of the crime that’s destroying our cities. | | | Americans are struggling with the inevitable consequences of the Left’s agenda, and they’re desperate for the conservative solutions Republicans have to offer. | | That’s why the men and women I’ve talked with are voting for Republicans in today’s election. They’re ready for change, and more importantly, they’re ready for conservative solutions. | | | | | Once the results start coming in tonight, it’s important to remember that our victories will mean nothing if Republicans fail to prove we deserve to be there. Every Republican who wins today must show up and start working on day one. We can’t continue to blame Democrats for all of America’s failures. We have to step up and do something about it. I endorsed more than 60 conservatives who I’m confident will do just that. Many of the endorsed candidates are fighting it out in neck and neck races. We’ve done everything in our power to get them this far, and now the final result rests with the American people. | | | | | Make sure you cast your ballot today. name: Charlie Crist
subject: Thank you, Florida
disclaimer_text: Paid for and approved by Charlie Crist, Democrat for Governor
body:
|
---

| | |
---
My friends,
I can’t thank you enough for raising your voices with me, for standing up for our freedoms and for our democracy. I am eternally grateful for your support – and for all Floridians who care so much for our beautiful state.
Unfortunately, tonight did not turn out the way we hoped.
We were the underdog from the minute I entered this race 18 months ago. I knew we would be outspent. I knew we would not have as many television ads. But you know me. I am an optimist. I love Florida.
Together, we stood up for our democracy and our freedoms, and we treated everyone with dignity and respect. I am very proud of that – and you should be, too.
I was welcomed into your homes and businesses, from Pensacola to Miami, from Jacksonville to Tampa.
I talked with women, who want to make their own decisions about their bodies. Black and Hispanic Floridians, who want the same opportunities as everyone else.
Members of the LGBTQ community, who want to be treated with the same respect as everyone else. Jewish leaders concerned with rising anti-Semitism.
Teachers who deserve our praise. Small business owners who just want a fair shot to be successful. Families who want to live in safe communities, send their kids to good schools and live productive lives.
Florida is a melting pot, and I believe in all my heart that our diversity is our greatest strength.
I encourage everyone to embrace our diversity, to focus on meeting our common challenges, on creating a Florida where everyone can be successful regardless of race, gender, ethnicity or sexual orientation. I know we all want what’s best for the state we all love.
I want to thank so many people who made this journey with me. My parents, my sisters and my fiancé for standing with me every step of the way.
My amazing campaign staff, which fought side by side with me every day and jumped over hurdle after hurdle.
All of our tremendous volunteers, who spent months making calls and waving signs and encouraging their friends and neighbors to vote.
And of course, all of the voters who believed in us, who love Florida, and who stood up for democracy and freedom. I am eternally grateful.
Throughout my career in public service, I have always worked for you. I have always tried to treat everyone with respect and dignity – to follow the Golden Rule and treat everyone the way we would want to be treated.
It’s an old rule and it can seem a little out of date in today’s politics - but to me, that’s why it’s more important than ever to hold fast to it.
I have been blessed by your support, and it has been an honor to serve Floridians in elected office in four different decades. I will always love Florida, and I will always love you for joining me on this journey.
God bless you.
Charlie

name: Jared Polis
subject: Thank you, Colorado!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POLIS FOR COLORADO
body:
It’s official! The Associated Press has called our race, and the people of Colorado have spoken.

It’s official! The Associated Press has called our race, and the people of Colorado have spoken. It is the honor of my life to continue serving as Colorado’s Governor for another four years. **First, friend, I want to say thank you. We wouldn’t have won once, let alone twice, without incredible grassroots supporters like you.** No matter how you contributed to this movement — whether you knocked on doors, donated a few dollars, shared your ideas at a campaign event, or encouraged your friends and family to vote — I will always be grateful for you, friend. **For Lt. Gov. Primavera and me, the mission has always been a simple one: Do what’s right for Colorado. Deliver real progress that improves people’s lives.** Tonight, I’m thinking about Coloradans like Karissa from Commerce City, who can finally stop rationing her life-saving medicine because of the historic cap we passed on the cost of insulin. I’m thinking about Julie and Aaron, who are saving thousands thanks to free full-day Kindergarten. I’m thinking about Giles, a small business owner, who was able to weather the pandemic because of tax cuts and support for small businesses we provided. **Here in Colorado, we’ve shown what kind of progress is possible when we are practical and data-driven. And we’ve proven that saving people money and protecting their freedoms is a great way to bring people together.** I believe to my core that Colorado’s best days are still ahead. Though there are real challenges in front of us, I know we will come together to face them, and I can’t wait to get right back to work. Again, Team, thank you for everything. \- Jared

That means we only have a few hours to mobilize voters to the very end and
fight back against Brian Kemp and his allies’ voter suppression tactics.

body:
We did it!

https://jaredforflorida.com/ [https://jaredforflorida.com/]
Dear Friends,
The votes are in, and I’m honored to announce that I will represent FL-23 in Congress!
https://jaredforflorida.com/ [https://jaredforflorida.com/]
And it’s all thanks to supporters like you, friends. I am humbled and honored by the incredible support our campaign received.

We are not going back to the chaos and division of Donald Trump and his allies. We are moving forward from the failed trickle-down economic policies of the past forty years, which have left Coloradans working harder for less, while the rich and the powerful get farther ahead. **In Colorado, we stand ready to protect the right to choose nationwide, rebuild the middle class, bring manufacturing jobs back to America, and create an economy that truly works for everyone.** That is what Coloradans have demanded in this election, and whether you voted for me or not, I will fight for your family the same way I fight for my own. I will work to hand the next generation not only a stronger economy — but a stronger democracy and a stronger America. Thank you for standing with me. Whether you volunteered, donated, spread the word, or simply voted yourself, I could not have won this election without you. I look forward to continuing to fight alongside you for a better Colorado. Thank you, Michael |

THANK YOU, VERMONT! | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54336751/378198906/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NjFlMzNmOS1kZjVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7daNCya02UF-njQdU15OSjDacfpTPg22PFX4IYbAwyE=&emci=cb385764-7e5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&emdi=761e33f9-df5f-ed11-819c-002248258d2f&ceid=43402272) | THANK YOU, VERMONT! **I am humbled, grateful, and excited beyond measure to be your Congresswoman-Elect.** Tonight we reaffirm that Vermont, and this nation, is still a place where _anything_ is possible. We’re still capable of change and progress. Tonight, after 231 years, Vermonters are sending a woman to Congress for the first time. To everyone who voted, knocked doors, made calls, chipped in, and helped us spread the word: This win belongs to YOU! I will never forget the enormity of your efforts, your hope and faith, and your deep commitment to this movement and to this state. I know many of us feel like we are in dark times. And it can be easy to feel cynical about our politics. But if we had believed the conventional wisdom, if we had believed that change was impossible, I would not be here tonight. So please take note, and take heart: **Vermont is a place where kindness, integrity, and courage matter. Vermont is a place where the daughter of an immigrant and a working class mom can become the first woman and first gay person to represent Vermont in the U.S. House of Representatives. ** While our victory here tonight marks another leap forward in the movement for progress, massive challenges lay ahead. The future of our democracy, our planet, and our most fundamental rights will be impacted by the party that wins control of Congress tonight. But no matter the outcome, I give you my word that I will not back down in Washington. I will carry your hopes and wishes with me. I will stay rooted in our communities here in Vermont, and fight for Vermont values with everything I have, including climate action, universal healthcare, liveable wages, reproductive rights, the safety of queer and trans people, racial equity, common sense gun laws, and a better life for the next generation. **So thank you, Peter, for your support, your time, your donations, your votes, and most of all, for trusting me to be your next member of Congress. Together, we have made history – and I’m so excited for what’s to come. ** Your Congresswoman-Elect, Becca Balint

Tonight we reaffirm that Vermont, and this nation, is still a place where anything is possible. We’re still capable of change and progress. Tonight, after 231 years, Vermonters are sending a woman to Congress for the first time. To everyone who voted, knocked doors, made calls, chipped in, and helped us spread the word: This win belongs to YOU! I will never forget the enormity of your efforts, your hope and faith, and your deep commitment to this movement and to this state. I know many of us feel like we are in dark times. And it can be easy to feel cynical about our politics. But if we had believed the conventional wisdom, if we had believed that change was impossible, I would not be here tonight. So please take note, and take heart: Vermont is a place where kindness, integrity, and courage matter. Vermont is a place where the daughter of an immigrant and a working class mom can become the first woman and first gay person to represent Vermont in the U.S. House of Representatives. While our victory here tonight marks another leap forward in the movement for progress, massive challenges lay ahead. The future of our democracy, our planet, and our most fundamental rights will be impacted by the party that wins control of Congress tonight. But no matter the outcome, I give you my word that I will not back down in Washington. I will carry your hopes and wishes with me. I will stay rooted in our communities here in Vermont, and fight for Vermont values with everything I have, including climate action, universal healthcare, liveable wages, reproductive rights, the safety of queer and trans people, racial equity, common sense gun laws, and a better life for the next generation. So thank you, Peter, for your support, your time, your donations, your votes, and most of all, for trusting me to be your next member of Congress. Together, we have made history – and I’m so excited for what’s to come. body:
Polls close tonight at 7:00 pm! If you haven’t voted yet, there’s still time but you need to act fast. As long as you’re in line at 7:00 pm, your vote counts. And please, DO NOT LEAVE THE LINE if you are in it at 7:00 pm! | | |
---
| | Peter,

Polls close tonight at 7:00 pm! If you haven’t voted yet, there’s still time but you need to act fast. As long as you’re in line at 7:00 pm, Peter, **your vote counts. And please, DO NOT LEAVE THE LINE if you are in it at 7:00 pm! ** In this race to reject the career politicians and reclaim our state, we’re fighting **tooth and nail to get every last voter who supports our mission** to show up to vote **TODAY!** There are no do-overs. This. Is. It. _**Peter, we can’t afford to let even one friend or family member stay home today. If you or a loved one is just getting off work, we NEED you to GET OUT and VOTE TONIGHT!**_ For a list of polling locations near you, please visit [markronchetti.com/vote](http://links.markronchetti.com/u/click?_t=b07bd752cdb64edc94e23391776d0f53&_m=c9786b8a1b974183b8c9e3fd6e239e73&_e=Ez3AhgkTPBjodrA9QJr7rmXuKs4rTxGdUTsyW3a3a82V3ei098JsHMUOtPReNap1ukyJ0rvLgcGDf29t3WwdEUis9QtSdkuvsG_bwJ4-A9WX8pGYHbgfr9JcsBjNQJq6M-DD-dBSlRXjA3Ekx_AUbp6sK5MRiTIaz8DpILKSxpyrLbStYePKWLzXdGObvnngo-A19wmpY07TFt7JpkyJQQ%3D%3D). This race is going to come down to the wire, Peter. Are you prepared for the consequences if MLG **wins** tonight? Just think about everything she’s given us over the last four years:
* Our schools are the **worst in the nation,** and they’re only getting worse
* Our streets are **riddled** with violent crime and drug and human trafficking because of MLG’s soft-on-crime policies, hurting innocent New Mexicans every day
* Our businesses are **suffering** under the weight of state regulations and taxes, all for our state government to **prioritize themselves over your business and your family**

**Today’s vote is about believing that better is possible.** We have everything we need to turn things around in New Mexico, but we may never get that chance if **you don’t vote tonight.**
Make sure you get to the polls **by 7:00 pm so that YOUR vote can count.** Check where your closest polling location is and get in line as fast as possible, Peter: [markronchetti.com/vote

subject: Tonight’s election results
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Whaley/Stephens
body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54336782/378199796/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYThjNWRiMi1lMzVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=G4k0IDAOSZkgwrnJuWG9M5zaLXNMJs5B1eNGCRGxl5A=)

**Friends, thank you.**
A few minutes ago I called Governor DeWine to congratulate him and wish him and Fran good luck in another term.
This is obviously not the result we were hoping for, but even when we don’t get the outcome we hope for, it’s vital that we respect our democracy.
This is a tough night, and there’s a lot that’s pretty broken about Ohio and our whole country. But there’s a lot that’s not.
I was the first woman ever nominated for governor in the state of Ohio. And I sure as hell know I won’t be the last, no matter how hard the good old boys in both parties and the media try to hold us back.
Despite trailing in every single poll, we raised millions of dollars – not from special interests looking to call in a favor, but from thousands of folks willing to chip in a few bucks to make their state a better place.
I traveled to every single county in this state – all 88 of them. Even when I met folks who didn't agree with me on everything, we could agree that every community and family deserved real opportunity.
Despite a broken state government and politicians working to divide us, it's still clear to me that we have more in common than not, and we must work together to create a future for us, together.
We don’t have to accept the status quo in our state. We don’t have to accept the extremists who have rigged the statehouse. We don’t have to accept decline.
We can and we will keep working for something better, even when we get knocked down. Because our families and communities are worth it.
And we will keep fighting for abortion rights. Since _Roe_ was overturned, I’ve said we need to take this issue directly to voters with a ballot initiative to codify abortion rights in the Ohio state constitution. That work starts now.
If you care about the future of this state, we need you in this fight. Tonight we can mourn this loss, but tomorrow we get back to work.
The last 20 months have been filled with highs and lows. And while tonight wasn’t the high we had hoped for, I still believe in Ohio. I still believe that our citizens deserve better than what they’re getting, and believe in the people of this state to get us there.
I’m going to keep fighting for Ohio, and I hope you will join me.
Thank you.
Onward,
Nan Whaley

* * *
Paid for by Friends of Whaley/Stephens

disclaimer_text: Paid for by James for NY
body:
| | | Peter, thank you.

**Moments ago, I was re-elected for a second term as your Attorney General.**
---
Together, we showed that when New Yorkers stand up and show up for the values we believe in – inclusion, equality, fairness, and justice – nothing can stop us.

**Peter, I wanted to take a moment to say thank you, from the bottom of my heart. **
Regardless of whether you contributed your hard-earned money to my campaign, attended my rallies, campaigned on my behalf, or even just took a few minutes here and there to read my messages, _you_ helped make this day possible.

I am ready to keep fighting for you as your Attorney General. We have accomplished so much in four years, but we have so much more to do. Throughout our nation, the gun violence and opioid epidemics continue to ravage our communities, millions of people are still without safe abortion access, LGBTQ+ folks are still being discriminated against, and climate change remains one of the largest threats of our lifetimes.
I hope you will take a moment to celebrate this historic victory with me. We’ve all earned a few hours of rest. Tomorrow, we’ll get back to work fighting until there is only one system of justice for all.

Thank you for everything, Peter. I hope I can continue to make you proud.

Attorney General Letitia James

name: Emilia Sykes
subject: the highest honor of my life
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Emilia Sykes for Congress
body:
Thank you, thank you, thank you. It is an honor to write to you as the Congresswoman-elect for Ohio’s 13th Congressional District. I am truly humbled that the people of my community have entrusted me to serve.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/54336842/378200328/-1743402759?refcode=em_info_2022.11.08_b5_es_all-nd&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTEyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNGU0N2UyZC1lNzVmLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThkMmYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5FCHvkMhLEbrv09nrI_SHpOM5PToTFQK0IvWvWpNHt8=)
Family, friends, neighbors, and members of this incredible people-powered team —

Thank you, thank you, thank you.

**It is an honor to write to you as the Congresswoman-elect for Ohio’s 13th Congressional District.** I am truly humbled that the people of my community have entrusted me to serve.

Tonight’s win belongs to all of us. Because Northeast Ohioans have always been – _and always will be_ – at the heart of our movement. We’re here right now because each and every one of you – every person who donated, everyone who contributed their time and energy into this campaign, every voter who showed up to send a loud and clear message about the kind of leadership our community deserves.

But let me be clear: Whether you voted for me, voted for my opponent, or chose not to vote at all, I want you to walk away from tonight knowing that I will always be in your corner. In me, you have a listener, a fighter, and someone that will always carry your voice with them.

_**Because that’s the type of representation Northeast Ohio deserves.**_

From day one in Washington, I’ll get to work fighting to lower costs, expand affordable healthcare, defend Social Security, bring more good-paying union jobs back home, defend a woman’s right to choose, and make the day-to-day just a little bit easier.

So while we may have passed the finish line today – and brought home a win for the Birthplace of Champions – _tonight is only the beginning._

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for believing in me. I’ll spend everyday fighting to make you proud. Let’s get to work.

Thank you,

Emilia
---

**A native of Akron, Ohio, Emilia Sykes has deep roots fighting for Ohioans. She learned from a young age how to use her voice and the power of the people to create change.** **As the _State Representative for Akron_ and _Ohio's State House Minority Leader_ , _Emilia cut through the divisiveness to deliver results_.**
